t715742.movie_title: トレンケ・ラウケン Part 2
t715742.tmdb_overview_en: With the strange disappearance of Laura, two colleagues, her older boyfriend, Rafael, and Ezequiel, learn of their recent discoveries, which may help them locate her. However, the story is bigger and stranger than they could imagine.

t836723.movie_title: ミッション・ジョイ 〜困難な時に幸せを見出す方法〜
t836723.movie_title_jp: Mission: Joy - Finding Happiness in Troubled Times
t836723.movie_title_en: Mission: Joy - Finding Happiness in Troubled Times
t836723.clean_title_jp: Mission: Joy - Finding Happiness in Troubled Times
t836723.movie_title_original: Mission: Joy - Finding Happiness in Troubled Times
t836723.synopsis: 困難に直面した時、私たちはどのように幸せを見出すことができるのか？ チベット仏教の最高指導者ダライ・ラマ14世と、南アフリカのアパルトヘイト撤廃運動の指導者の一人、デズモンド・ツツ大主教という2人のノーベル平和賞受賞者が、宗教の違いを超えてその答えを導き出す深い知恵と喜びに満ちた世紀の対談を元にしたドキュメンタリー。
t836723.synopsis_en: When faced with difficulties, how can we find happiness? This documentary is based on the historic dialogue between two Nobel Peace Prize laureates—the 14th Dalai Lama, supreme leader of Tibetan Buddhism, and Archbishop Desmond Tutu, one of the leaders of South Africa's anti-apartheid movement—who transcend religious differences to derive answers filled with deep wisdom and joy.
t836723.tmdb_overview_en: An exploration of the remarkable friendship between Archbishop Desmond Tutu and His Holiness the Dalai Lama.

nカンタティモール.synopsis: 舞台は南海に浮かぶ神々の島、2002年にインドネシアから独立を果たした東ティモール。 ひとつの歌から始まった運命の旅が、音楽あふれるドキュメンタリー映画となった。この島を襲った悲劇と、生き抜いた人々の奇跡。その姿が世界に希望の光を投げかける。 ★アフタートーク開催！ 9月25、26日は広田監督（オンラインにて）、27日は南風島渉さんです。
nカンタティモール.synopsis_en: The setting is the island of the gods floating in the South Seas—East Timor, which achieved independence from Indonesia in 2002. A fateful journey that began with a single song became a documentary film overflowing with music. The tragedy that struck this island, and the miracle of the people who survived it. Their story casts a light of hope upon the world.

t1244492.movie_title: ルックバック ※9/11公開の実写映画ではありません
t1244492.synopsis_en: Hirokazu Kore-eda, of "Shoplifters" and "Monster," directs, writes, and edits a live-action film adaptation of the manga by Tatsuki Fujimoto, known for "Chainsaw Man," which was published in 2021 and whose theatrical anime version also generated significant buzz. The film carefully traces the 13-year journey of two girls bound by their earnest devotion to manga, set against the beautiful changing seasons primarily filmed in Kahoku City, Akita Prefecture. Fujino, a confident fourth grader, serializes a four-panel manga in the school newspaper and is praised by her classmates. One day, however, she sees a manga by Kyomoto, a reclusive classmate, published in the school paper, and is crushed by its overwhelming artistic skill. From then on, Fujino devotes herself to drawing manga in hopes of improving, but unable to close the gap with Kyomoto, she eventually gives up. On graduation day, she delivers Kyomoto's diploma to her home and learns that Kyomoto was a fan of her manga. Bound by their earnest love for manga, Fujino and Kyomoto begin creating manga together, building irreplaceable moments, until an event occurs that profoundly shakes their daily lives. Nozomi Deguchi of "All Greens" stars as Fujino, and Aju Makita of "Happiness" plays Kyomoto. Masaki Suda appears as the manga editor Maeda, Kankuro Kudo as Tamai, the teacher at Fujino and Kyomoto's elementary school, and Kayo Noro as Fujino's mother Akari. Music is composed by Yuta Bandoh, who won the Best Music Award at the 45th Japan Academy Prize for "Belle." Screened in the competition section of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival in 2026.
t1244492.tmdb_overview_en: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.
t1244492.tmdb_overview_jp: 学年新聞で４コマ漫画を連載している小学４年生の藤野。クラスメートから絶賛され、自分の画力に絶対の自信を持つ藤野だったが、ある日の学年新聞に初めて掲載された不登校の同級生・京本の４コマ漫画を目にし、その画力の高さに驚愕する。以来、脇目も降らず、ひたすら漫画を描き続けた藤野だったが、一向に狭まらない京本との画力差に打ちひしがれ、漫画を描くことを諦めてしまう。  しかし、小学校卒業の日、教師に頼まれて京本に卒業証書を届けに行った藤野は、そこで初めて対面した京本から「ずっとファンだった」と告げられる。  一度は、漫画を描くことを諦めるきっかけとなった京本と、今度は一緒に漫画を描き始めた藤野。二人の少女をつないだのは、漫画へのひたむきな思いだった。しかしある日、すべてを打ち砕く事件が起きる…。

t996764.movie_title: にわのすなば GARDEN SANDBOX ※26(土),27(日)は休映
t996764.synopsis_en: The first feature film produced by Kinokoya, a cafe bar in Tama, Tokyo, that screens independent films. Sakaguchi visits an unfamiliar town called Tobako for a job interview at a friend's invitation, but finding the work unreasonable, he turns down the job and tries to go home. However, for some reason he can't leave easily, and as he wanders the town he repeatedly encounters mysterious meetings and partings. Filmed in Ryoke, Kawaguchi City, Saitama Prefecture, an area once prosperous from casting industries and still home to factory districts, the film captures traces of suburban landscapes being lost amid the changing times through the figure of its wandering protagonist. The cast includes Kawashima Marino ("Fuyu suru Sakai me") and Murakami Yukino ("Orphans' Blues," "On the Street"). Directed by Kurokawa Yukinori ("Village on the Village").
t996764.tmdb_overview_en: After some misunderstanding, Sakaguchi is hired to make a tourist guide video on Tobako (a fictitious name for Kawaguchi) in the outskirts of Tokyo. This element in the script sparks off a fanciful wandering strewn with unexpected meetings. First with Kitagawa, thanks to whom Sakaguchi landed the job. Then with a seamstress, and then with Yoshino, with whom a half-hearted romance emerges. Thus the narrative unfolds, in halts and swerves, espousing unexpected meetings, and offering the strolling character an opportunity for displacements from one place to the next. The deserted town has come to a standstill - the shooting took place during the lockdown - and this acts as a metaphor for the idleness of the characters. GARDEN SANDBOX is light and nimble, whereas its main character hasa limp. Her demeanour and her stiff body exude a peculiar quality, somewhat comically at odds with the setting.

t1599751.synopsis: 歌人の山中千瀬が初めて映画の脚本を手がけ、海辺の故郷を離れて音信不通となった姉妹の再会をつづった中編映画。 都会での単調な毎日に生きる意味を見失っていた姉・くーちゃんのもとに、妹・さきちゃんから突然電話がかかってくる。故郷ではない海辺で会うことにした姉妹は、かつて一緒に読んだ一編の詩をきっかけに、共通の記憶と感情を呼び起こされていく。記憶と夢が混ざりあい、現実と想像が絡みあう世界で、姉妹は新たな脱出の旅を始める。 山中千瀬が自身の詩「脱出の最中」をタイトルに執筆したオリジナル脚本に、山中の創作「夢日記」からの引用を加え、映画と言葉のコラボレーションに挑戦。姉妹の再会の物語を「断片化された言葉」と「身体」の再会のメタファーとしてとらえ、人と人とが時間と場所を再び共有することの新たな感覚を紡ぎだす。 「オーガスト・マイ・ヘヴン」の村上由規乃が妹・さきちゃん、「ふゆうするさかいめ」のカワシママリノが姉・くーちゃんを演じた。東京・多摩市で映画の上映やシネクラブを行なっているカフェバー「キノコヤ」が製作を手がけ、「にわのすなば GARDEN SANDBOX」「ヴィレッジ・オン・ザ・ヴィレッジ」の黒川幸則監督がメガホンをとった。
t1599751.synopsis_en:
Poet Chise Yamanaka pens her first screenplay for this medium-length film, depicting the reunion of two sisters who had lost touch after leaving their seaside hometown. Ku-chan, the elder sister, has lost her sense of purpose amidst the monotony of city life when she receives an unexpected phone call from her younger sister, Saki-chan. Choosing to meet at a beach away from their childhood home, a poem they once read together serves as a catalyst, awakening shared memories and emotions. In a world where memory and dreams blend and reality and imagination intertwine, the sisters embark on a new journey of "escape."

Based on Yamanaka’s original script titled after her poem "In the Midst of Escape" and incorporating excerpts from her "Dream Diary," the film explores the collaboration between cinema and language. It frames the sisters' reunion as a metaphor for the reconciliation of "fragmented words" and "the body," weaving a fresh perspective on the shared experience of time and space.

Yukino Murakami (*August My Heaven*) stars as Saki-chan, while Marino Kawashima (*Floating Boundary*) plays Ku-chan. The film was produced by Kinokoya, a cafe-bar and cine-club in Tama, Tokyo, and directed by Yukinori Kurokawa (*Garden Sandbox*, *Village on the Village*).

t29967.tmdb_overview_en: Set in the eighteenth century, Moonfleet is about John Mohune, a young orphan who is sent to the Dorset village of Moonfleet to stay with an old friend of his mother's, Jeremy Fox. Fox is a morally ambiguous character, an elegant gentleman involved with smugglers and pirates.

t198654.synopsis: 「狂った果実」「月曜日のユカ」などの鬼才・中平康が自身のプロダクション・中平プロの第1弾として1971年に手がけた作品で、幕末の土佐で活動した天才絵師・絵金の生きざまを映画化。20歳の青年・金蔵がさまざまな出来事を経て、残酷描写や過激な性表現、ユーモアが混在した作風で知られる異端の絵師「絵金」となるまでの姿を描き、第24回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品されるも、そのあまりの血みどろな描写で物議をかもした。 20歳の絵師・金蔵は長身でたくましい体躯だが、傲慢で不潔という不名誉な陰口を叩かれていた。江戸に遊学していた彼は3年ぶりに故郷・土佐に戻り、「絵金」として活動を始める。権力にあらがい己のみを信じて描きあげた絵金の作品は、やがて多くの人々を魅了するようになる。 主人公・絵金を麿赤兒が鬼気迫る演技で怪演し、扇ひろ子、加賀まりこが共演。榎本滋民の「血みどろの絵金」を原作に、新藤兼人が脚本を手がけた。2025年10月には、新宿・K's cinemaで開催の「奇想天外映画祭2025」にてデジタルリマスター版で上映。
t198654.synopsis_en: A film by the maverick director Nakahira Ko, known for works like "Kurutta Kajitsu" and "Getsuyobi no Yuka," produced in 1971 as the first project of his own production company, Nakahira Pro. It depicts the life of Ekin, a genius painter active in Tosa at the end of the Edo period. The film portrays the journey of a 20-year-old youth named Kinzo as he goes through various events to become the heretical painter "Ekin," known for his style mixing cruel depictions, radical sexual expression, and humor. It was submitted to the competition section of the 24th Cannes International Film Festival, where its excessively bloody depictions caused controversy. Kinzo, a 20-year-old painter, is tall and sturdy, but is subjected to the dishonorable gossip of being arrogant and filthy. After studying in Edo, he returns to his hometown of Tosa after three years and begins working as "Ekin." Ekin's works, painted in defiance of authority and trusting only in himself, eventually captivate many people. Maro Akaji gives a hauntingly intense performance as the protagonist Ekin, with Ogi Hiroko and Kaga Mariko co-starring. Based on Enomoto Shigemi's "Chimidoro no Ekin," with a screenplay by Shindo Kaneto. In October 2025, a digitally remastered version will be screened at the "Kiten Tentai Eigasai 2025" held at K's cinema in Shinjuku.
t198654.tmdb_overview_en: The film depicts the youth of Kinzo, a heretic painter who worked in Tosa during the late Edo period, and the hurricane-like inner side of his life.

t1448773.synopsis: 初長編作品「(Instrumental)」が劇場公開された新鋭・宮坂一輝監督が手がけた作品で、気候変動に対するリアクションの違いからすれ違っていく恋人たちの姿を通じて、若者の本音を描き出した。インディーズ映画界の登竜門でもある第18回田辺・弁慶映画祭で俳優賞を受賞した。 私立大学社会学部3年の申田大樹は、同じ学部の同期である雪川翠と付き合っている。ある夏の日、2人は気候変動をテーマにした現代アートの展覧会を訪れる。そこに込められたメッセージを大樹は淡々と受け止めていたが、一方の翠はひどくショックを受け、動揺する。やがて翠は大学生活動家の森野美玖が率いる環境学生団体「CAFF（Climate Action For Future）」の活動に参加するようになる。戸惑いつつも翠の活動を見守っていた大樹だったが、お互いの考え方の違いが浮き彫りになるにつれ、次第に2人はすれ違っていく。 第18回田辺・弁慶映画祭では、出演の山下諒、二田絢乃、さいとうなりのアンサンブル演技に対して俳優賞が送られた。田辺・弁慶映画祭の受賞作品を上映する「田辺・弁慶映画祭セレクション2024」（24年5月9日～6月5日＝テアトル新宿／2024年6月20日～26日＝テアトル梅田）で劇場上映。
t1448773.synopsis_en: A new era youth romance film for all those who carry the burden of 'not being able to understand each other.' The latest work from up-and-coming director Kazuki Miyasaka, who made his theatrical feature debut with '(Instrumental),' is a love story depicting the conflicts of young people living in the modern age. The cast includes Ryo Yamashita, Ayano Nita, and Nari Saito, who each won the Actor Award at the 18th Tanabe Benkei Film Festival for this film, as well as rising young actors such as Haruto Yoshida and Koto Sekiguchi. A new masterpiece of youth romance cinema that reflects the era of 'now' has been born.
t1448773.tmdb_overview_jp: 私立大学社会学部三年の申田大樹は、同じ学部の同期である雪川翠と付き合っている。  ある夏の日、二人は気候変動をテーマにした現代アートの展覧会を訪れる。  込められたメッセージを淡々と受け止める大樹とは対照的に、翠はひどくショックを受け動揺する。  やがて翠は大学生活動家の森野美玖率いる環境学生団体、CAFF（Climate Action For Future）の活動に参加するようになる。  当初戸惑いつつも翠の活動を見守っていた大樹だったが、お互いの考え方の違いが浮き彫りになるにつれ、次第に二人はすれ違い始める。

t5165.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
t5165.synopsis: イタリアの巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニを代表する一作で、アントニオーニの代名詞ともいえる男女の「愛の不毛」を描き、論争を巻き起こしながらも第13回カンヌ国際映画祭で審査員賞を受賞した。 ローマの外交官の娘アンナは、恋人のサンドロや親友のクラウディアら友人たちとヨットで地中海の船旅に出るが、立ち寄った無人島で、アンナはふいに姿を消してしまう。残された恋人のサンドロと親友クラウディアは懸命にアンナの行方を捜すが手がかりはつかめず、ほかの友人たちは何事もなかったかのように日常へ戻っていく。捜索を続ける中でサンドロとクラウディアは、次第に距離を縮めていくが……。 クラウディア役を、「夜」「太陽はひとりぼっち」などアントニオーニのミューズとして知られるモニカ・ビッティが演じ、サンドロ役を「三月生れ」「女王陛下の007」のガブリエレ・フェルゼッティ、アンナ役を「狂った情事」のレア・マッサリが演じた。日本では1962年に劇場初公開。2026年8月、アントニオーニ初期5作を集めた特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ　レトロスペクティヴ　愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、4K修復版で公開。
t5165.synopsis_en: Sandro, his lover Anna, and her friend Claudia go sailing on a yacht. When they land on a certain island, Anna suddenly disappears. Sandro and Claudia search for her, but gradually find themselves drawn to each other, giving in to their desires despite their guilt.
t5165.tmdb_overview_en: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.
t5165.tmdb_overview_jp: ヨットで遠乗りに出かけたサンドロ、恋人のアンナ、その友人・クラウディア。とある島に上陸すると、突然アンナが姿を消してしまう。サンドロとクラウディアは彼女を捜し回るが、2人は次第に惹かれあい、やましさを覚えながらも求めてしまう。

n愛と殺意.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
n愛と殺意.synopsis: イタリアが誇る巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニが1950年に発表した長編デビュー作。資本家の妻とその元恋人が織りなす愛憎劇をノワール調に描いたドラマ。 ミラノの資本家エンリコは、美しい妻パオラの過去の素行を探偵に調査させる。皮肉にも、その調査がきっかけとなってパオラはかつての恋人グイドと再会する。愛のない結婚生活に飽きていた彼女は、グイドとの関係に情熱を取り戻していく。夫による調査が進むなか、2人は次第に危険な関係へと足を踏み入れていく。 パオラを演じるのは、「リュミエール」「ラスト・ハーレム」などに出演したミラノ出身の女優ルチア・ボゼー。元恋人グイド役を、「郵便配達は二度ベルを鳴らす」「夏の嵐」などルキノ・ビスコンティ作品への出演で知られるマッシモ・ジロッティが務めた。現代人の孤独や男女の愛の不毛を見つめ続けたアントニオーニが、その後の作品にも通じる人間関係の疎外を、早くも描き出した一作。日本では2026年8月の特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ レトロスペクティヴ 愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、4K修復版で劇場初公開。
n愛と殺意.synopsis_en: The feature-length debut by Italy's master filmmaker Michelangelo Antonioni, released in 1950. A noir-toned drama of love and hatred woven between a capitalist's wife and her former lover. Milan capitalist Enrico hires a detective to investigate the past conduct of his beautiful wife Paola. Ironically, this investigation leads Paola to reunite with her former lover Guido. Bored with her loveless marriage, she rediscovers passion in her relationship with Guido. As her husband's investigation progresses, the two gradually step into a dangerous affair. Paola is played by Milan-born actress Lucia Bosè, who appeared in "Lumière" and "Last Harem." The role of former lover Guido is played by Massimo Girotti, known for his appearances in Luchino Visconti works such as "The Postman Always Rings Twice" and "Summer Storm." In this work, Antonioni—who continually examined modern loneliness and the futility of love between men and women—already depicts the alienation in human relationships that would carry through his later films. In Japan, it will receive its theatrical premiere in a 4K restored version at the special screening series "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: The Futility of Love, Wandering Souls" in August 2026.

nクロードシャブロル傑作選vol2ベティ.movie_title: ＜クロード・シャブロル傑作選 Vol.2＞ ベティ
nクロードシャブロル傑作選vol2ベティ.movie_title_jp: ＜クロード・シャブロル傑作選 Vol.2＞ ベティ

n私はモーリーンカーニー正義を殺すのは誰シャブロルのミューズたち.movie_title: 私はモーリーン・カーニー 正義を殺すのは誰？ ＜シャブロルのミューズたち＞
n私はモーリーンカーニー正義を殺すのは誰シャブロルのミューズたち.movie_title_jp: 私はモーリーン・カーニー 正義を殺すのは誰？ ＜シャブロルのミューズたち＞

t925714.movie_title: 私はモーリーン・カーニー　正義を殺すのは誰？
t925714.movie_title_jp: 私はモーリーン・カーニー　正義を殺すのは誰？
t925714.director: ジャン＝ポール・サロメ
t925714.synopsis: イザベル・ユペールが主演を務め、フランスの原子力会社の労働組合代表が国家的スキャンダルに巻き込まれていく姿を、実話を基に描いた社会派サスペンス。 世界最大の原子力企業アレバ社のフランス民主労働組合代表を務めるモーリーン・カーニーは、中国とのハイリスクな極秘取引を知り、会社の未来と従業員の雇用を守るため内部告発をする。やがてモーリーンは自宅で襲われるが、権力側は彼女の自作自演だと自白を強要。モーリーンは屈することなく、政府の閣僚や企業のトップを相手に捨て身の覚悟で立ち向かっていく。 共演は「デリシュ！」のグレゴリー・ガドゥボワ、「ヒトラー　最期の12日間」のアレクサンドラ・マリア・ララ。「ルーヴルの怪人」のジャン＝ポール・サロメがメガホンをとり、サロメ監督と「ローズメイカー　奇跡のバラ」のファデット・ドゥルアールが共同で脚本を担当。
t925714.synopsis_en: A social thriller starring Isabelle Huppert, based on a true story, depicting a French nuclear company union representative who becomes embroiled in a national scandal. Maureen Kearney, the French Democratic Confederation of Labour representative at Areva, the world's largest nuclear energy company, learns of a high-risk secret deal with China and becomes a whistleblower to protect the company's future and employees' jobs. Maureen is later attacked at her home, but those in power force her to confess that she staged it herself. Unbowed, Maureen courageously takes on government ministers and corporate leaders at her own peril. Co-stars include Grégory Gadebois from "Delicious" and Alexandra Maria Lara from "Downfall." Jean-Paul Salomé of "The Phantom of the Louvre" directs, co-writing the screenplay with Fadette Drouard of "The Rose Maker."
t925714.tmdb_overview_en: The true story of the Irish national Maureen Kearney- head tradeunion representative-turned-whistleblower of a French multinational nuclear powerhouse. After denouncing top-secret deals that shook the sector, Kearney’s life is suddenly turned upside-down when she is violently assaulted in her own house.

t98246.director: アレクサンドル・ソクーロフ
t98246.synopsis: 「精神の声」「エルミタージュ幻想」などで知られるロシアの鬼才アレクサンドル・ソクーロフ監督が、「モレク神」（ヒトラー）、「牡牛座」（スターリン）に次ぐ、20世紀の権力者を描く4部作の3作目として製作した問題作。神と崇められていた昭和天皇が、終戦を期に「人間宣言」するまでの心の葛藤を描く。昭和天皇にイッセー尾形、皇后に桃井かおり、侍従長に佐野史郎が扮している。
t98246.synopsis_en: August 1945. Emperor Showa, separated from the Empress and the crown prince who had been evacuated, was living in an underground air-raid shelter. At an imperial conference, when the Army Minister advocates a decisive battle on the mainland, the Emperor recites a poem by Emperor Meiji, suggesting his willingness to surrender. Waking from a nightmare of the Great Tokyo Air Raid, the Emperor is escorted by his chamberlain to a meeting with Douglas MacArthur, the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. The Emperor tells MacArthur that he is prepared to accept any decision made by the Allied Powers.
t98246.tmdb_overview_en: A re-imagination of Japanese Emperor Hirohito’s final days in power as WWII draws to a close.
t98246.tmdb_overview_jp: １９４５年８月。昭和天皇は疎開した皇后や皇太子たちと離れ、地下待避壕での生活を送っていた。御前会議で本土決戦を提唱する陸軍大臣に対し、天皇は明治天皇の歌を詠み、降伏の用意があることを示唆する。東京大空襲の悪夢にうなされて目を覚ました天皇は、侍従の迎えで占領軍最高司令官であるダグラス・マッカーサーとの会見に向かう。天皇はマッカーサーへ、連合国のどのような決定も受け入れる準備があると告げる。

t2786.director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
t2786.synopsis: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダールが1965年に発表し、ヌーベルバーグの金字塔的作品として語り継がれる代表作。 「ピエロ」と呼ばれるフェルディナンは、退屈な結婚生活から抜け出したいという衝動に駆られ、偶然再会した昔の恋人マリアンヌと一夜を過ごす。翌朝、見知らぬ男の死体を見つけた2人は逃避行を始めるが、やがてマリアンヌはフェルディナンに嫌気がさし、ギャングと通じてフェルディナンを裏切る。 2016年にデジタルリマスター＆寺尾次郎氏による新訳版が公開。2022年および2026年に2Kレストア版で公開。
t2786.synopsis_en: A masterpiece by Jean-Luc Godard, released in 1965 and revered as a cornerstone of the French New Wave. Ferdinand, called 'Pierrot,' is driven by an urge to escape his boring married life and spends a night with his former lover Marianne, whom he meets by chance. The next morning, finding a dead stranger, the two go on the run, but Marianne eventually tires of Ferdinand and betrays him by colluding with gangsters. A digitally remastered version with a new translation by Jiro Terao was released in 2016. A 2K restored version was released in 2022 and 2026.
t2786.tmdb_overview_en: Pierrot escapes his boring society and travels from Paris to the Mediterranean Sea with Marianne, a girl chased by hit-men from Algeria. They lead an unorthodox life, always on the run.
t2786.tmdb_overview_jp: 金持ちの妻と結婚して退屈な毎日を送っていたフェルナンドは、再会した昔の愛人マリアンヌと一晩を過ごす。翌朝、部屋には首に鋏を突き立てられた男の死体があった。

t146949.program_title: ジャンルを越え、時代を越えるーーイ・マニ特集
t146949.synopsis_en: Set during the Korean War, it depicts a Marine unit marching while bringing along a girl who has been orphaned.
t146949.tmdb_overview_en: A division of marines survive a battle with the Chinese army but find themselves stranded without contact on the wrong side of the front.
t146949.tmdb_overview_jp: 朝鮮戦争を舞台に、孤児になった少女を連れて行軍する海兵部隊の姿を描く。

t224756.movie_title: タブロイド紙が映したドリアン・グレイ
t224756.movie_title_jp: タブロイド紙が映したドリアン・グレイ
t224756.movie_title_en: Dorian Gray in the Mirror of the Yellow Press
t224756.clean_title_jp: Dorian Gray im Spiegel der Boulevardpresse
t224756.movie_title_original: Dorian Gray im Spiegel der Boulevardpresse
t224756.director: ウルリケ・オッティンガー
t224756.synopsis: ニュー・ジャーマン・シネマの時代から精力的に活動し、2020年ベルリン国際映画祭でベルリナーレカメラ（功労賞）を受賞したドイツの映画作家ウルリケ・オッティンガーによる「ベルリン3部作」の第3作。 オスカー・ワイルドの長編小説「ドリアン・グレイの肖像」やフリッツ・ラング監督による映画「ドクトル・マブゼ」などをモチーフにした独自の世界観を描き出す。 伝説のスーパーモデル、ベルーシュカ・フォン・レーンドルフがドリアン・グレイを演じ、「去年マリエンバートで」のデルフィーヌ・セイリグ、「アル中女の肖像」のタベア・ブルーメンシャインが共演。日本では2023年8月に劇場初公開。
t224756.synopsis_en: The third installment of the "Berlin Trilogy" by German filmmaker Ulrike Ottinger, who has been actively working since the era of New German Cinema and received the Berlinale Camera (Honorary Award) at the 2020 Berlin International Film Festival. It depicts a unique worldview inspired by Oscar Wilde's novel "The Picture of Dorian Gray" and Fritz Lang's film "Dr. Mabuse," among other sources. Legendary supermodel Veruschka von Lehndorff plays Dorian Gray, with Delphine Seyrig of "Last Year at Marienbad" and Tabea Blumenschein of "A Portrait of a Female Drunkard" co-starring. It was released theatrically in Japan for the first time in August 2023.
t224756.tmdb_overview_en: The final installment in Ulrike Ottinger’s Berlin Trilogy (following TICKET OF NO RETURN and FREAK ORLANDO) casts Delphine Seyrig as the nefarious Fritz Lang supervillain Dr. Mabuse, here the head of a powerful media empire that seeks to create headlines by manufacturing (and then publicly destroying) its own celebrity: the wealthy, handsome playboy Dorian Gray.

t531753.synopsis: 「野火」「六月の蛇」の塚本晋也監督が、池松壮亮と蒼井優を迎えて描いた自身初の時代劇。250年にわたって続いてきた平和が、開国か否かで大きく揺れ動いた江戸時代末期。江戸近郊の農村を舞台に、時代の波に翻弄される浪人の男と周囲の人々の姿を通し、生と死の問題に迫る。文武両道で才気あふれる主人公の浪人を池松、隣人である農家の娘を蒼井が演じ、「野火」の中村達也、オーディションで抜擢された新人・前田隆成らが共演。「沈黙　サイレンス」など俳優としても活躍する塚本監督自身も出演する。2018年・第75回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
t531753.synopsis_en: Director Shinya Tsukamoto, known for "Fires on the Plain" and "A Snake of June," directs his first period film, starring Sosuke Ikematsu and Yu Aoi. Set in the late Edo period, when 250 years of peace were shaken by the debate over whether to open the country to the outside world, the story unfolds in a farming village on the outskirts of Edo, following a ronin tossed about by the tides of the era and the people around him, confronting questions of life and death. Ikematsu plays the protagonist ronin—gifted in both letters and martial arts—while Aoi plays a neighboring farmer's daughter. They are joined by Tatsuya Nakamura of "Fires on the Plain" and newcomer Takanari Maeda, selected through an audition. Tsukamoto himself, who also acts in films such as "Silence," appears in the cast. The film was selected for the competition section of the 75th Venice International Film Festival in 2018.
t531753.tmdb_overview_en: In mid-19th century Edo period, a masterless rōnin named Mokunoshin Tsuzuki resides in a peaceful village among those he helps. However, as the prevalent peace and tranquility are sure to be replaced by war and conflict across the land, the swordsman feels restlessness creeping upon him.

t31427.synopsis: 1959年に市川崑により映画化された大岡昇平の同名小説を塚本晋也の監督、脚本、製作、主演により再び映画化。日本軍の敗北が濃厚となった第2次世界大戦末期のフィリピン戦線。結核を患った田村一等兵は部隊を追放され、野戦病院へと送られる。しかし、野戦病院では食糧不足を理由に田村の入院を拒絶。再び舞い戻った部隊からも入隊を拒否されてしまう。空腹と孤独と戦いながら、レイテ島の暑さの中をさまよい続ける田村は、かつての仲間たちと再会する。戦場という異常な空間で極限状態に追い込まれた人間たちが描かれる。共演にリリー・フランキー、俳優デビュー作の「バレット・バレエ」以来の塚本監督作品への参加となるドラマーの中村達也。
t31427.synopsis_en: An anti-war film adapted from Shōhei Ōoka's novel of the same name, scripted by Kazuo Wada and directed by Kon Ichikawa. Abandoned by both the hospital and his unit, Tamura wanders the island of Leyte on the Philippine front. He reunites with fellow retreating soldiers in front of a hospital, but when the hospital comes under shelling, Tamura flees alone. With no food and having lost his comrades, Tamura survives by eating grass. Eventually he reunites with his former comrades Nagamatsu and Yasuda, who had been separated from him. The two call the soldiers they killed 'monkeys' and have been eating their flesh...
t31427.tmdb_overview_en: In the closing days of WWII, a Japanese soldier afflicted with tuberculosis is abandoned by his company and left to wander the Philippine island of Leyte.
t31427.tmdb_overview_jp: 大岡昇平の同名小説を、和田夏十が脚色し市川崑が監督した反戦映画。病院にも部隊にも見放された田村は、フィリピン戦線のレイテ島をさまよっていた。同じように敗走している仲間と病院の前で合流するが、その病院が砲撃を受けたため、田村は一人で逃げ出す。食べるものもなく、仲間を失った田村は、草を食べて生き延びていた。やがて生き別れたかつての仲間である永松と安田と再会。二人は殺した味方の兵士を“猿”と称し、その肉を食べていた…。

t23522.movie_title: ブック・オブ・ライフ
t23522.movie_title_jp: ブック・オブ・ライフ
t23522.tmdb_overview_en: New Year's Eve takes on new meaning when the Devil, Jesus Christ, and Christ's assistant Magdalena discuss and debate the End of the World.

t1187431.synopsis: 「トラスト・ミー」「シンプルメン」などでニューヨークのインディペンデントシーンを象徴する映画作家として知られるハル・ハートリーが、コロナ禍での制作中止を乗り越えて完成させた、11年ぶりとなる長編監督作品。隠遁状態だった映画監督が、余命わずかと勘違いされたことから起こる騒動を描くドタバタ喜劇。 58歳のジョー・フルトンは、かつてロマンチックコメディで人気を博した映画監督だが、今は半ば引退状態にあった。時間を持て余すのはよくないと考え、近所にある墓地で管理人の求人が出ていたことから、その仕事に応募する。一方、ジョーの恋人でテレビ界のスター、ミュリエルは、ジョーが遺言書を作ろうとしていることを知り、彼が余命わずかで終活しているのだと早とちりしてしまう。その勘違いはたちまち周囲にも広まっていき、ジョーのアパートには友人や知人、さらには見知らぬ若者たちまでが押しかけてくる。 ハートリー自身を思わせる主人公ジョー・フルトン役を、「シンプルメン」で主人公兄弟の弟を演じたビル・セイジが務めた。そのほか、「シンプルメン」「ブラック・クランズマン」のロバート・ジョン・バーク、「トラスト・ミー」「アバター　ウェイ・オブ・ウォーター」のイーディ・ファルコらが共演する。
t1187431.synopsis_en: Hal Hartley, known as a filmmaker symbolizing the New York independent scene with works like "Trust" and "Simple Men," completed this feature film after overcoming production halts during the COVID-19 pandemic, his first in 11 years. This slapstick comedy depicts the turmoil that ensues when a reclusive film director is mistakenly believed to have little time left to live. Joe Fulton, 58, is a film director who once found popularity with romantic comedies but is now semi-retired. Thinking it's not good to have too much free time, he applies for a caretaker job at a nearby cemetery. Meanwhile, Joe's lover, TV star Muriel, learns that Joe is trying to make a will and jumps to the conclusion that he is terminally ill and putting his affairs in order. This misunderstanding quickly spreads to those around him, and friends, acquaintances, and even strangers flock to Joe's apartment. Bill Sage, who played the younger brother in "Simple Men," plays the protagonist Joe Fulton, who resembles Hartley himself. Also starring are Robert John Burke of "Simple Men" and "BlacKkKlansman," and Edie Falco of "Trust" and "Avatar: The Way of Water."
t1187431.tmdb_overview_en: Joseph Fulton, a famous director, wants to work at a cemetery. Meanwhile, he has his last will and testament drawn up. His girlfriend thinks he's dying. Rumor spreads and soon everyone he knows gathers to say their last farewells.

t37410.synopsis: 1990年代ニューヨーク・インディペンデント映画界の名匠ハル・ハートリーが、自称天才作家ヘンリーと彼に詩の才能を見出された青年サイモンの交流をオフビートに描き、第51回カンヌ国際映画祭で脚本賞を受賞したヒューマンコメディ。ニューヨークのクイーンズ地区で暮らす内気な青年サイモンは、自由奔放な姉フェイやうつ病の母メアリーを養うため、ゴミ収集人として冴えない人生を歩んでいた。そんな彼の日常が、謎めいた浮浪者の男ヘンリー・フールが自宅地下室に住み着いたことで一変。天才作家を自称するヘンリーに勧められて詩を書き始めたサイモンは思わぬ才能を発揮し、詩人として注目を集めるようになるが……。2006年の「フェイ・グリム」、14年の「ネッド・ライフル」へと続く「ヘンリー・フール3部作」の第1作。日本では99年に劇場初公開。2018年4月に大阪シアターセブン、5月に東京・アップリンク渋谷の「ハル・ハートリー復活祭」でリバイバル上映。
t37410.synopsis_en: This human comedy, by Hal Hartley, a master of the 1990s New York independent film scene, offbeatly depicts the interaction between Henry, a self-proclaimed genius writer, and Simon, a young man in whom Henry discovers poetic talent, and won the screenwriting award at the 51st Cannes Film Festival. Simon, a shy young man living in Queens, New York, leads a dreary life as a garbage collector to support his free-spirited older sister Fay and his depressed mother Mary. His daily life is transformed when a mysterious vagrant named Henry Fool moves into his basement. Encouraged by Henry, who calls himself a genius writer, Simon begins writing poetry, discovers an unexpected talent, and gains attention as a poet, but... This is the first film in the "Henry Fool trilogy," followed by "Fay Grim" (2006) and "Ned Rifle" (2014). It had its theatrical premiere in Japan in 1999. It was revived in April 2018 at Theater Seven in Osaka and in May at Uplink Shibuya in Tokyo during the "Hal Hartley Resurrection Festival."
t37410.tmdb_overview_en: An egocentric bum transforms the lives of a shy New Jersey garbageman and his sister.

t72443.movie_title_en: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
t72443.synopsis: 田辺聖子の短編小説を犬童一心監督が実写映画化。妻夫木聡と池脇千鶴が共演し、足の不自由な少女と平凡な大学生の切ない恋の行方を描く。ごく普通の大学生・恒夫がアルバイトする麻雀店では、近所に出没する謎の老婆の噂が話題となっていた。その老婆は決まって明け方に現れ、乳母車を押しているのだという。明け方、恒夫は坂道を下ってくる乳母車に遭遇。近寄って中を覗くと、そこには包丁を振り回すひとりの少女がいた。ジョゼと名乗るその少女は足が不自由で、祖母に乳母車を押してもらい散歩していたのだ。不思議な魅力を持つジョゼに惹かれた恒夫は、彼女の家をたびたび訪れるようになる。
t72443.synopsis_en: [Reason for choosing this film] I was a high school student who would wander endlessly around a TSUTAYA that could only be reached by car driven by my parents. I would carefully narrow down which five DVDs to rent for a thousand yen, as selectively as possible. "Josee, the Tiger and the Fish" was a film I picked up during that time. Josee, played by Ikeshima Chizuru, has a disability in her legs and lives in a wheelchair. Through her encounter with Tsuneo, a university student played by Tsumabuki Satoshi, Josee's world expands dramatically. But—at the time, I couldn't fully digest the emotions depicted in the film with just one viewing. Especially in the latter half, Josee's monologue on the shell-shaped bed—I watched it over and over throughout the entire one-week rental period. It was my first movie experience where I clearly recognized: "This depicts emotions I cannot possibly grasp as I am now." And regarding this film, there is perhaps an even more unforgettable viewing experience than the main feature itself. That is the commentary track by director Inudō Isshin and both Ikewaki and Tsumabuki. Now I live in a world where, far from "five DVDs for a thousand yen," I can watch tens of thousands of titles for a few thousand yen a month—but I find myself longing for the many bonus features that came with most rental products, which I lost in exchange for that convenience. I have an insatiable appetite for bonus features. Making-of footage and deleted scenes are fine, but above all, I adore commentary tracks where directors and cast members share behind-the-scenes stories while watching the film. And it was none other than "Josee, the Tiger and the Fish" that instilled this habit in me. The voices of the three in the commentary were overflowing with pride and excitement at having brought this film into the world. The behind-the-scenes stories revealed one after another were fascinating, but after watching, what I thought above all was: "I want to become an adult like them." At the time, I perceived becoming an adult and working as painful and difficult things. For someone like me, the sight of these three talking about their work with such light, effervescent joy seemed to shine dazzlingly, like pearls spilling from a shell.
t72443.tmdb_overview_en: A part-time employee in a mahjong parlour runs across a young woman, who is unable to walk, in baby carriage. He becomes friends with the woman and begins to feel enamoured with her.
t72443.tmdb_overview_jp: 大学生の恒夫は、ある朝バイト先の麻雀店から帰る途中、老婆の手を離れて坂道を転げ落ちてくる乳母車と遭遇。その乳母車の中にはひとりの少女が身を隠していた。足が不自由で歩けない彼女は、ときどき祖母に乳母車を押してもらっては気ままな散歩を楽しんでいたのだった。恒夫は、愛読書であるフランソワーズ・サガンの小説のヒロインの名から、自分のことをジョゼと称する風変わりな彼女に、少しずつ心惹かれるようになる。

nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.movie_title: セックス・ピストルズ　破壊の設計図
nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.movie_title_jp: セックス・ピストルズ　破壊の設計図
nセックスピストルズ破壊の設計図.synopsis_en: —1970s London, England— The birth of 'punk rock'— 'That's so punk!'— Its spirit began here. — The Sex Pistols — surely everyone has heard that name at least once. They were a 'punk' rock band that suddenly appeared in late 1970s London, completely rejecting the stagnant rock scene. Today, 'that's so punk' is used in everyday conversation, but that spirit was born here. The original bassist and ill-fated man, Glen Matlock, tells the whole story in this shocking alternative narrative. Featuring live footage and interviews from the era, as well as rare live performances by Glen Matlock. This masterpiece documentary depicts the interplay between truth and falsehood in show business, and between artistic expression and commercialism, while posing the universal question: 'Who is the true winner in life?'

t2767.synopsis: フランスの鬼才レオス・カラックスが「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」「汚れた血」に続いて手がけたラブストーリー。アレックスという名を持つ青年を主人公に描く3部作の完結編にあたる。 パリで最も古く美しい橋・ポンヌフで暮らす大道芸人のアレックスは、ある日、失恋の痛手と治る見込みのない目の病に苦しみ放浪する画学生ミシェルと出会う。やがて2人はポンヌフで共に暮らし始め、孤独な日々の中で絆を深めていく。ジュリアンというチェリストへの恋の未練と、画家としての失明への恐怖を抱えるミシェル。そして、他人とのつながりを知らずに生きてきたアレックス。2人の間には、次第に絆と愛が芽生えていく。しかし、ミシェルはやがて両親が自分を捜していること、そして眼病の治療法が見つかったことを知り……。 主人公アレックスを演じるのは、「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」「汚れた血」に続いてドニ・ラバン。ミシェル役にはジュリエット・ビノシュが扮する。1991年製作、日本では1992年に公開され、渋谷・シネマライズで27週に及ぶロングランを記録する大ヒットとなった。2011年にニュープリント／HDリマスター版でリバイバル上映され、2025年には撮影監督キャロリーヌ・シャンプティエ監修による4Kリマスター版としてリバイバル公開される。
t2767.synopsis_en:
A love story from French visionary Leos Carax, following *Boy Meets Girl* and *Bad Blood*, this film serves as the final chapter of his trilogy centered on a young man named Alex. On the Pont-Neuf, the oldest and most beautiful bridge in Paris, a street performer named Alex encounters Michèle, an art student wandering the streets while suffering from the pain of a broken heart and a seemingly incurable eye disease. Before long, the two begin living together on the bridge, deepening their bond amidst their shared loneliness. Michèle struggles with lingering feelings for a cellist named Julien and the fear of losing her sight as an artist, while Alex has lived his life without ever knowing a true connection to others. Gradually, a profound love blossoms between them. However, Michèle eventually learns that her parents are searching for her and that a cure for her eye disease has been found...

Denis Lavant returns to play the protagonist Alex, following his roles in *Boy Meets Girl* and *Bad Blood*, while Juliette Binoche portrays Michèle. Produced in 1991 and released in Japan in 199

nmetライブビューイング201011ワーグナーニーベルングの指環第1夜ワルキュ.movie_title: METライブビューイング2010-11 ワーグナー《ニーベルングの指環》　第1夜「ワルキューレ」
nmetライブビューイング201011ワーグナーニーベルングの指環第1夜ワルキュ.movie_title_jp: METライブビューイング2010-11 ワーグナー《ニーベルングの指環》　第1夜「ワルキューレ」
nmetライブビューイング201011ワーグナーニーベルングの指環第1夜ワルキュ.director: 、本編開始21分間の“主演不在”に言及
nmetライブビューイング201011ワーグナーニーベルングの指環第1夜ワルキュ.synopsis: 米ニューヨーク・メトロポリンタン歌劇場（MET）で行われる最新のオペラ公演を劇場のスクリーンで上映する「METライブビューイング」2010～11年シーズンの12作目。ワーグナーの全4部からなる大作オペラ「ニーベルングの指環」の第2部。主神ボータンが人間に産ませた兄妹ジークムントとジークリンデはお互いを知らずに育ち、禁断の愛に落ちてしまう。ジークムントはジークリンデの夫フンディングと決闘することになり、ボータンの娘ブリュンヒルデはジークムントを勝たせようとするが、自身の思いと神としての立場の間で葛藤（かっとう）するボータンはそれを阻む。
nmetライブビューイング201011ワーグナーニーベルングの指環第1夜ワルキュ.synopsis_en: The 12th work of the 2010-11 season of 'MET Live in HD,' which screens the latest opera performances from the Metropolitan Opera in New York on theater screens. The second part of Wagner's epic four-opera cycle 'Der Ring des Nibelungen.' The siblings Siegmund and Sieglinde, fathered by the chief god Wotan with a mortal, grow up without knowing each other and fall into forbidden love. Siegmund is forced into a duel with Sieglinde's husband Hunding. Wotan's daughter Brünnhilde tries to let Siegmund win, but Wotan, torn between his own feelings and his position as a god, prevents it.

nmetライブビューイング202526ワーグナートリスタンとイゾルデ.movie_title: METライブビューイング2025-26 ワーグナー《トリスタンとイゾルデ》
nmetライブビューイング202526ワーグナートリスタンとイゾルデ.movie_title_jp: METライブビューイング2025-26 ワーグナー《トリスタンとイゾルデ》
nmetライブビューイング202526ワーグナートリスタンとイゾルデ.director: 、本編開始21分間の“主演不在”に言及
nmetライブビューイング202526ワーグナートリスタンとイゾルデ.synopsis: ニューヨーク・メトロポリタン歌劇場（MET）の最新オペラ公演を映像収録し、映画館で上映する「METライブビューイング」2025～26シーズンの第6作。全編が官能的な音楽で埋め尽くされたワーグナーによる究極の愛のオペラを、ヤニック・ネゼ＝セガンによる革新的な新演出と、リーゼ・ダービドセンの陶酔的な歌唱で描く「トリスタンとイゾルデ」を収録（2026年3月21日上演舞台を収録）。 伝説上の中世。アイルランドの王女イゾルデはコーンウォールのマルケ王と政略結婚するため、王の甥で忠臣のトリスタンが漕ぐ船に乗り出立する。トリスタンはイゾルデのかつての婚約者の仇で、彼に対し愛憎入り交じる気持ちを抱えるイゾルデは服毒心中を図る。しかし侍女ブランゲーネがイゾルデに渡したのは媚薬であったため、2人は狂おしく愛し合う。イゾルデは王妃になってからもトリスタンとの逢瀬を続けるが、やがて密会の場にマルケ王と重臣メロートが帰還し、トリスタンはメロートの剣で深手を負ってしまう。
nmetライブビューイング202526ワーグナートリスタンとイゾルデ.synopsis_en:
The sixth production of the 2025–26 "MET Live Viewing" season, which brings the latest performances from the Metropolitan Opera (MET) in New York to the big screen. This installment features Wagner’s ultimate opera of love—a work overflowing with sensual music—presented through an innovative new production by Yannick Nézet-Séguin and the rapturous vocals of Lise Davidsen (scheduled to be recorded on March 21, 2026).

In the legendary Middle Ages, the Irish princess Isolde sets sail for Cornwall to enter a political marriage with King Marke, traveling on a ship helmed by the King’s nephew and loyal vassal, Tristan. Because Tristan is the slayer of her former fiancé, Isolde harbors a complex mix of love and hate toward him and attempts a double suicide by poison. However, her maid Brangäne gives her a love potion instead, leading the two to fall into a maddening passion. Although Isolde continues her trysts with Tristan even after becoming Queen, King Marke and his courtier Melot eventually return to the site of their secret meeting, where Tristan is gravely wounded by Melot’s sword.

t1136423.director: C・プーレム・クマール
t1136423.tmdb_overview_en: Twenty-two years after losing his home, Arulmozhi Varman returns to his native Thanjavur to attend his cousin's wedding. Amidst the celebrations, Arul is reintroduced to an upbeat man whom he cannot recall. With the help of the unknown man, Arul reconnects with his past.

t348879.synopsis: 「PASSION」「THE DEPTHS」で注目を集める新鋭・濱口竜介と「ホームスイートホーム」の酒井耕が共同監督でで手がけた東北記録映画3部作の第1部で、東日本大震災で津波被害を受けた人々の「対話」を集めたドキュメンタリー。岩手県宮古市田老地区から福島県相馬郡新地町まで南下しながら、家族や仲間など親しい者同士が震災とその後について語り合う姿を映し出す。被災地の悲惨な映像ではなく人々の日常的な対話を捉えることで、そこから生まれる被災者たちの感情をすくい取っていく。
t348879.synopsis_en: The first installment of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ko Sakai (*Home Sweet Home*) and rising filmmaker Ryusuke Hamaguchi, who garnered acclaim for *PASSION* and *THE DEPTHS*. This documentary gathers the "dialogues" of those affected by the tsunami during the Great East Japan Earthquake. Traveling south from the Taro district of Miyako City in Iwate Prefecture to the town of Shinchi in Fukushima’s Soma District, the film captures family members and friends as they speak with one another about the disaster and its aftermath. By focusing on everyday conversation rather than tragic imagery of the disaster zones, the film distills the raw emotions of the survivors that emerge through their shared words.
t348879.tmdb_overview_en: The first part of a trilogy focusing on the northeast Tohoku region, co-directed by Sakai Ko and Hamaguchi Ryusuke. Impromptu interviews were carried out with disaster victims mainly along the Sanriku Coast, which had been ravaged by tsunamis several times prior to the Great East Japan Earthquake of 2011, and makes emotional discoveries within dialogues between close-knit people including families and workmates.

t348885.movie_title: なみのこえ　新地町
t348885.movie_title_jp: なみのこえ　新地町
t348885.clean_title_jp: なみのこえ　新地町
t348885.movie_title_original: なみのこえ　新地町
t348885.synopsis: 濱口竜介と酒井耕が共同監督を務めた東北記録映画3部作の第2部「なみのこえ」の新地町編。2011年3月11日の東日本大震災で津波被害を受けた人々の「対話」を捉えた前作「なみのおと」に続き、震災から約1年を経た被災者たちが、家族や友人、仕事仲間たちとともに当時の様子やその後について語り合う姿を収める。岩手県から福島県におよぶ広範囲で取材を行った前作に対し、本作では地域を福島県相馬郡新地町に絞って6組10名の対話を収録している。
t348885.synopsis_en: The second part of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi and Ko Sakai, 'Voices from the Waves,' set in Shinchi Town. Following the previous work 'Tales from the Waves,' which captured the 'dialogues' of people affected by the tsunami on March 11, 2011, this film records survivors about a year after the disaster as they talk with family, friends, and colleagues about what happened and how they have been since. While the previous film conducted interviews across a wide area from Iwate to Fukushima Prefectures, this installment focuses specifically on Shinchi Town in Soma District, Fukushima Prefecture, recording dialogues among 10 people in 6 groups.
t348885.tmdb_overview_en: A companion piece to Voices from the Waves Kesennuma that forms half of the second installment in a documentary trilogy on the Tohoku region, co-directed by Sakai Ko and Hamaguchi Ryusuke. It captures dialogues between closely-linked people in accordance with the directors' objective of passing on experiences of the Great East Japan Earthquake, which is inspired by the folk tale tradition of the Tohoku region.

t348886.movie_title_jp: なみのこえ　気仙沼

t348886.movie_title_original: なみのこえ　気仙沼
t348886.synopsis: 濱口竜介と酒井耕が共同監督を務めた東北記録映画3部作の第2部「なみのこえ」の気仙沼編。2011年3月11日の東日本大震災で津波被害を受けた三陸沿岸部に暮らす人々の「対話」を集めた前作「なみのおと」の完成から1年以上にわたって撮影を続け、宮城県気仙沼市に暮らす7組11名の対話を記録。震災から約1年を経た中で、被災した人々が家族や友人、仕事仲間たちとの会話を通して震災の記憶を呼び起こし、思いを新たにしていく様子を映し出す。
t348886.synopsis_en: The second part of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi and Ko Sakai, 'Voices from the Waves,' set in Kesennuma. Continuing to film for over a year after completing the previous work 'Tales from the Waves,' which gathered 'dialogues' of people living along the Sanriku coast affected by the tsunami on March 11, 2011, this film records dialogues among 11 people in 7 groups living in Kesennuma City, Miyagi Prefecture. About a year after the disaster, it depicts survivors recalling their memories of the earthquake through conversations with family, friends, and colleagues, and renewing their feelings.
t348886.tmdb_overview_en: A companion piece to Voices from the Waves Shinchimachi that forms half of the second installment in a documentary trilogy on the Tohoku region, co-directed by Sakai Ko and Hamaguchi Ryusuke. Through numerous interviews, they concentrate on the experiences and emotions of people, not as victims but as individuals.

t348882.synopsis: 「PASSION」の濱口竜介と「ホームスイートホーム」の酒井耕が共同監督を務める東北記録映画3部作の第3部で、東日本大震災の被災者たちの対話を集めた前2作に続き、東北地方に伝わる民話語りを記録したドキュメンタリー。民話研究者の小野和子を聞き手に迎え、方言の抑揚豊かな3人の語り手たちが民話の語り聞かせを披露。語り手と聞き手の間に生まれる民話独特の空気が、創造的なカメラワークによってスクリーンに映し出されていく。
t348882.synopsis_en: The third part of the Tohoku documentary trilogy co-directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi ('PASSION') and Ko Sakai ('Home Sweet Home'). Following the first two works that collected dialogues of Great East Japan Earthquake survivors, this documentary records folk tales passed down in the Tohoku region. With folk tale researcher Kazuko Ono as the listener, three storytellers with richly inflected dialects perform their tales. The unique atmosphere that arises between storyteller and listener is brought to the screen through creative camerawork.
t348882.tmdb_overview_en: The third part of a trilogy focusing on the Tohoku region that is comprised of dialogues with victims of the Great East Japan Earthquake. Ideas on how to share experiences of the disaster with future generations, a challenge touched upon in the previous films The Sound of Waves and Voices from the Waves, is found in folk tales from the region. Co-directed by Sakai Ko and Hamaguchi Ryusuke.

t487850.synopsis: 4人の女性の日常と友情を5時間を越える長尺で丁寧に描き、ロカルノ、ナントなど、数々の国際映画祭で主要賞を受賞した「ハッピーアワー」で注目された濱口竜介監督の商業映画デビュー作。第71回カンヌ国際映画祭のコンペティション部門に出品された。芥川賞作家・柴崎友香の同名恋愛小説を東出昌大、唐田えりかの主演により映画化。大阪に暮らす21歳の朝子は、麦（ばく）と出会い、運命的な恋に落ちるが、ある日、麦は朝子の前から忽然と姿を消す。2年後、大阪から東京に引っ越した朝子は麦とそっくりな顔の亮平と出会う。麦のことを忘れることができない朝子は亮平を避けようとするが、そんな朝子に亮平は好意を抱く。そして、朝子も戸惑いながらも亮平に惹かれていく。東出が麦と亮平の2役、唐田が朝子を演じる。
t487850.synopsis_en: The commercial film debut of director Ryusuke Hamaguchi, who gained attention for "Happy Hour," a film that meticulously depicted the daily lives and friendships of four women over more than five hours and won major awards at numerous international film festivals including Locarno and Nantes. This film was entered into the Competition section of the 71st Cannes International Film Festival. It is an adaptation of the award-winning love novel of the same name by Akutagawa Prize-winning author Tomoka Shibasaki, starring Masahiro Higashide and Erika Karata. Asako, a 21-year-old living in Osaka, meets Baku and falls into a fateful love, but one day, Baku suddenly disappears from her life. Two years later, having moved from Osaka to Tokyo, Asako meets Ryohei, who has a face identical to Baku's. Unable to forget Baku, Asako tries to avoid Ryohei, but he develops feelings for her. Despite her hesitation, Asako finds herself drawn to Ryohei. Higashide plays the dual roles of Baku and Ryohei, while Karata plays Asako.
t487850.tmdb_overview_en: Asako lives in Osaka. She falls in love with Baku, a free-spirit. One day, Baku suddenly disappears. Two years later, Asako now lives in Tokyo and meets Ryohei. He looks just like Baku, but has a completely different personality.
t487850.tmdb_overview_jp: 麦(東出昌大)と朝子(唐田えりか)は恋に落ちるが、麦は彼女の前から突然居なくなってしまう。それから2年がたち、彼女は麦との思い出が残る大阪を離れて東京で暮らし始める。ある日、麦と外見はそっくりだが性格の違う亮平(東出昌大)と出会う。麦のことを忘れられないがゆえに彼を避けていたが、一方の亮平はそんな彼女に強く惹かれる。亮平と接するうちに彼に惹(ひ)かれていく朝子だったが......。

t780.movie_title_en: The Passion of Joan of Arc
t780.director: カール・テオドア・ドライヤー
t780.synopsis_en: Based on Joseph Delteil's novelized account of the 'Trial of Joan of Arc,' this is undoubtedly a pinnacle of silent cinema. The harshness of the scene where Joan, tortured as the 'devil's child,' yields once to suffering and has her hair cut as a prisoner (a close-up of her actually having her hair cut and weeping), and the moment when she regains herself, deliberately faces the stake, is set ablaze, and writhes in agony—a pain that pierces the viewer (also rendered in striking close-up).
t780.tmdb_overview_en: A classic of the silent age, this film tells the story of the doomed but ultimately canonized 15th-century teenage warrior. On trial for claiming she'd spoken to God, Jeanne d'Arc is subjected to inhumane treatment and scare tactics at the hands of church court officials. Initially bullied into changing her story, Jeanne eventually opts for what she sees as the truth. Her punishment, a famously brutal execution, earns her perpetual martyrdom.
t780.tmdb_overview_jp: ジョゼフ・デルテーイの小説版による“ジャンヌ・ダルク裁判”の物語で、間違いなくサイレント映画の一つの到達点だろう。“悪魔の子”とされ拷問を受けるジャンヌが苦しみに一度は屈服し、囚人として髪を刈られるシーンの厳しさ（実際に髪を切られ涙するクローズ・アップ）、そして自分を持ち直し、あえて火刑台に向かい火にかけられ、苦悶に顔を歪める瞬間、見る者をも貫く痛み（これも鮮烈なクローズ・アップで表現される）。

n時間ですよデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: . 銭湯「泉湯」の女主人(森光子)は大の働き者だが、その夫(中村勘三郎)は女癖が悪くいつも遊んでいた。ある日近所の未亡人が妊娠、しかもその相手が女主人の夫だという噂が立ち...。「ただの水で稼ごうなんて、水商売もいいとこだわ」など橋田セリフの切れ味は素晴らしく、女性の働き方や生活保護問題など、すでに令和の社会問題を扱っている。森光子は石井の母と交流があった。 . .
n時間ですよデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: The proprietress of the public bathhouse Izumiyu (Mitsuko Mori) is a hard worker, but her husband (Kanzaburo Nakamura) is a womanizer who is always out playing around. One day, a neighborhood widow becomes pregnant, and rumors spread that the father is the proprietress's husband... Hashida's dialogue is razor-sharp, as in lines like 'Trying to make a living with just plain water—that's the bathhouse business for you,' and the story already deals with social issues relevant to the Reiwa era, such as women's working conditions and public assistance. Mitsuko Mori had a personal connection with Ishii's mother.

n廃市デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: . 舞台は九州の柳川、人々は死んだような町で死んだように生きていた。郁代(南田洋子)は夫・直之(仲谷昇)が妹の安子(大空眞弓)に想いを寄せているという噂に傷つき、家を出て寺にこもってしまう。閉塞感の中で渦巻く男女の激情とは裏腹に、川辺のロケシーンはまるでルノワールの絵画のようにどこまでも美しい。 . .
n廃市デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: Set in Yanagawa, Kyushu, where people live as if dead in a town that itself seems to have died. Ikuyo (Yoko Minamida) is wounded by rumors that her husband Naoyuki (Noboru Nakaya) has feelings for her younger sister Yasuko (Mayumi Ozora), and she leaves home to shut herself away in a temple. Beneath the stifling sense of entrapment, the violent passions of men and women swirl — yet, in stark contrast, the riverside location shots are endlessly beautiful, like paintings by Renoir.

t42112.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t42112.synopsis_en: The 13th feature film by French master director Robert Bresson, who left behind masterpieces such as "Resistance: From the Prisoner's Diary" and "Mouchette." Bresson, already over 80 at the time of filming, passed away in 1999, making this his final work. Based on the novella "The Forged Coupon" by Russian literary giant Leo Tolstoy, it depicts the life of Yvon, a young fuel delivery man who, after unknowingly using a counterfeit bill that falls into his hands, triggers a family massacre and spirals downward. The title "L'argent" means "money" in French. First released in Japan in 1986. Revived in 2011 as part of "Cinema Masterpiece Selection III: The Art of Robert Bresson" with new prints. In 2026, it will be revived again in a 2K restored version as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t42112.tmdb_overview_en: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.
t42112.tmdb_overview_jp: 「抵抗（レジスタンス）　死刑囚の手記より」「少女ムシェット」などの名作を残したフランスの名匠ロベール・ブレッソン監督が、ロシアの文豪トルストイの原作をもとに、偶然手にしてしまったニセ札を知らずに使ってしまったことから、一家惨殺事件を引き起こし転落していく人生を歩む青年イボンの姿を描いた。

n映画しびれ.synopsis: 日本海沿いの町に暮らす少年、大地は、幼少期に暴君のようだった父の影響から言葉を発しない。今は母の亜樹と暮らしているが、夜の仕事で生計を立てざるを得ない亜樹はほとんど家に帰らず、生活は苦しい。やがて亜樹と共に叔母の家に身を寄せるが、どこにも居場所はなく、ひとりで過ごしては内気になっていった。大地は父の行方を求めて生家を訪ねることを決意。これを境に、彼の運命は大きく揺らいでいく———。心のよるべなき貧困、誰にも見つからぬように生きる孤独の中のささやかな救い、母への複雑な感情。流されるままに生きているようで、歩みを止めない大地。そんな彼がかすかな光を手繰り寄せ、息をのむような大きな愛を知るまでの20年間が、少年の姿を追い続け、リアリズムに根ざした視点で綴られていく。
n映画しびれ.synopsis_en: Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, has been unable to speak since childhood due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant. He now lives with his mother Aki, but she is forced to make a living through night work and is rarely home, making their life difficult. Eventually, they take shelter at his aunt's house, but he finds no place to belong anywhere, and as he spends time alone, he grows increasingly introverted. Daichi decides to visit his childhood home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken. Poverty with no emotional anchor, small comforts amid the loneliness of living unseen by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi appears to drift through life, yet never stops moving forward. The twenty years until he grasps at a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are chronicled through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's journey.

nベイシティローラーズウッディウッドが語る真実.movie_title: ベイ・シティ・ローラーズ ウッディ・ウッドが語る真実
nベイシティローラーズウッディウッドが語る真実.movie_title_jp: ベイ・シティ・ローラーズ ウッディ・ウッドが語る真実
nベイシティローラーズウッディウッドが語る真実.movie_title_en: Rollercoaster: The Story of Bay City Roller Stuart 'Woody' Wood
nベイシティローラーズウッディウッドが語る真実.synopsis: 集団ヒステリーで観客が次々と気絶し、コンサートがたびたび中止となった、1970年代を代表するポップロックバンド、ベイ・シティ・ローラーズ。 絶頂期にはライブ、空港、ホテルの往復の日々だったが、78年頃からバンドが崩壊し始める。メンバーのスチュアート・ウッディ・ウッドは、81年に一度脱退。再結成ツアーに参加したりしながらも、ロサンゼルス、南アフリカに移住してバンドを組むなど、自らの道を模索。 30代に入り、89年にスコットランドに戻ると、後に妻となるデニースと出会う。90年代初めに、みすぼらしい車から出るところを写真に撮られ、自分に我慢ならなくなり、過去に生きるのに疲れていた彼は、イギリス初の音楽ビジネス講座を開いていたゴードン・キャンベルと意気投合。 時に「ケルティック・スピリット」名義でケルトのアンビエント・ミュージックをプロデュースするようになり、アルバム“Scottish Moods”はゴールドディスク、“The Lone Piper”はプラチナディスクに認定され、ビルボード・ワールド・チャート8位に入るなど、以降、本人が「一流リーグに戻った」と納得する活躍を続けている。
nベイシティローラーズウッディウッドが語る真実.synopsis_en: The Bay City Rollers were one of the defining pop-rock bands of the 1970s, with mass hysteria causing audience members to faint one after another and concerts frequently being cancelled. During their peak, they spent their days shuttling between live shows, airports, and hotels, but around 1978 the band began to fall apart. Member Stuart "Woody" Wood left the band once in 1981. While occasionally participating in reunion tours, he moved to Los Angeles and South Africa, forming bands and searching for his own path. Entering his thirties, he returned to Scotland in 1989, where he met Denise, who would later become his wife. In the early 1990s, he was photographed getting out of a shabby car, and unable to tolerate what he had become, exhausted from living in the past, he hit it off with Gordon Campbell, who was running the UK's first music business course. He eventually began producing Celtic ambient music under the name "Celtic Spirit," and the album "Scottish Moods" was certified gold while "The Lone Piper" went platinum and reached No. 8 on the Billboard World Chart. Since then, he has continued to thrive in ways that he himself acknowledges as "back in the big league."

t1670061.synopsis: チャンネル登録者数“２ケタ”の弱小大学生YouTuber・佐藤寛治は、ある日バイト先のネットカフェで客が置いていった怪しげなボストンバッグを発見する。 チャックを開けると、そこにはなんと1億円分の札束が入っていた！寛治は思わずバッグを持ち去ってしまうのだが、そこにはボケ始めた祖母との暮らしが理由にあった。
t1670061.synopsis_en: Kanji Sato is a struggling university student YouTuber with a mere double-digit subscriber count. One day, he discovers a suspicious Boston bag left behind by a customer at the internet cafe where he works part-time. When he opens the zipper, he finds it stuffed with 100 million yen in cash! Kanji impulsively takes the bag, driven by his need to care for his grandmother who has begun showing signs of dementia.
t1670061.tmdb_overview_jp: Wara nimo Sugaru Kemono tachi (藁にもすがる獣たち / Beasts Clutching at Straws) is a 2026 Japanese neo-noir crime suspense thriller directed by Hideo Jojo and written by Yasuko Kobayashi. Based on Keisuke Sone's 2011 novel, the film is set for a nationwide theatrical release in Japan on September 25, 2026, distributed by Toei.  The story centers on a lost gym bag containing 100 million yen in cash found at an internet café by a struggling YouTuber living with his ailing grandmother. The discovery triggers a chaotic and violent chain reaction, entwining a corrupt police officer indebted to the Yakuza, a scheming femme fatale, and ruthless criminals all fighting to claim the fortune. The ensemble cast stars Oji Suzuka, Hiroki Narimiya, Nana Mori, MEGUMI, and Jun Fubuki.

t1697647.movie_title_en: Shumei: The Living Legacy of Kabuki
t1697647.synopsis: 歌舞伎界の名門・市川家に受け継がれる最大の節目「十三代目市川團十郎白猿襲名披露」を真正面から捉えた本作。 コロナ禍による2年半の延期を乗り越え実現した歴史的瞬間を通して、市川團十郎が背負う「継承」と「個」の狭間で揺れる覚悟と葛藤を描き出す。 監督は世界的に活躍する映画監督・三池崇史、本作品が初のドキュメンタリー作品となる。 さらに、祝幕を手がけた村上隆による創作の様子も記録した、歌舞伎の“今”を映し出す壮麗なるドキュメンタリー作品。
t1697647.synopsis_en: This film directly captures the greatest milestone inherited by the prestigious Ichikawa family of the Kabuki world: the "13th Ichikawa Danjuro Hakuen Shumei Hirogaki" (name succession announcement). Through the historic moment realized after overcoming a two-and-a-half-year postponement due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it depicts the resolve and conflict of Ichikawa Danjuro swaying between "inheritance" and "individuality." The director is internationally acclaimed filmmaker Takashi Miike, and this marks his first documentary work. Furthermore, it records the creative process of Takashi Murakami, who created the celebratory curtain, making this a magnificent documentary that captures the "now" of Kabuki.
t1697647.tmdb_overview_en: A look at the succession ceremony in which Ichikawa Danjūrō XIII formally inherited the storied Danjūrō name in Kabuki, Japan’s classical performing art. The film records the behind-the-scenes preparations for the actor’s name-inheritance debut performance.
t1697647.tmdb_overview_jp: 歌舞伎界の名門・市川家に受け継がれる最大の節目 「十三代目市川團十郎白猿襲名披露」を真正面から捉えた本作。  コロナ禍による2年半の延期を乗り越え実現した歴史的瞬間を通して、 市川團十郎が背負う「継承」と「個」の狭間で揺れる覚悟と葛藤を描き出す。  監督は世界的に活躍する映画監督・三池崇史、本作品が初のドキュメンタリー作品となる。 さらに、祝幕を手がけた村上隆による創作の様子も記録した、歌舞伎の“今”を映し出す壮麗なるドキュメンタリー作品。

nしびれ.synopsis:
『佐々木、イン、マイマイン』(20)、『若き見知らぬ者たち』(24)の内山拓也監督最新作!
内山監督 の故郷である新潟を舞台に、居場所とアイデンティティを模索する少年の物語を自伝的作品として描く渾身の一作 『しびれ』 。
2025年11月に開催された第26回東京フィルメックスでは、日本作品で唯一、コンペティション部門に選出。マティアス・ピニェイロ監督ら審査員から「静寂と変化、柔らかさと硬さが内包され、バランス感覚に満ちた映画である」と評され、審査員特別賞を受賞。 そして、今年2月に開催された、世界三大映画祭の一つであるベルリン国際映画祭では、パノラマ部門に正式出品され、ベルリン国際映画祭ディレクターのマイケル・シュトゥッツから「観る者の心に⻑く余韻を残す作品」と高く評価された。
nしびれ.synopsis_en: Director Takuya Uchiyama, who swept newcomer awards at film festivals with "Sasaki, In, My Mind" and continued with "Young Strangers," consistently gazing at the youth of young people resisting reality and trying to grasp something, leaving a vivid impression on the film world, releases this passionate work—an autobiographical film set in his hometown of Niigata in winter, telling the story of a boy searching for a place to belong and his identity. Playing the adolescent protagonist Daichi is Takumi Kitamura. He brilliantly embodies the quiet anger toward his father who left him and his mother, and the heart wavering between love and hatred—contradictory emotions—toward his mother who raised him single-handedly. As his mother Aki, Rie Miyazawa gives her all to portray a mother whose innocent nature creates a life that instills loneliness in Daichi, yet whose every detail reveals a certain tenderness toward her son. And as his father Ohara, Masatoshi Nagase, with full maturity, shows a man who transforms from a tyrannical figure into one living out a sorrowful remaining life. Also, as the young Daichi, Tsukasa Enomoto, Anji Kato, and Hazuki Akimoto each express the loneliness, love, and life force swirling deep in his heart with innocent yet powerful gazes, driving the entire story forward. Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, stopped speaking due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant during his early childhood. He now lives with his mother Aki, but Aki, forced to make a living through night work, rarely comes home, and their life is hard. Eventually they move in with his aunt, but he has no place anywhere, and spending time alone, he grew introverted. Daichi decides to visit his old home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken——— Poverty with no emotional anchor, small salvation amid the loneliness of living so as not to be found by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi seems to live as if being swept along, yet he never stops walking. The 20 years until he grasps a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are depicted through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's figure throughout.

t1651263.synopsis: 日常的に暴力を振るう夫から逃げてきた紀子。絶望の中、入院先の看護師・路子に救われ、配偶者や親から暴力を受けた女性たちを匿うシェルター〈おうち〉に身を寄せる。そこでは暮らしのすべてが「持ち回り」というルールで成り立っていた。穏やかで守られた日々を取り戻していく紀子だが、少しずつ違和感を覚え始める。やがて〈おうち〉が“交換殺人”によって女性たちを解放している事実を知る。残るか去るか、選択を迫られる紀子。一方、とある事件を追う刑事・薫もまた夫からの暴力に苦しんでいた。疑われることのない夫・晋一と追い詰められていく現実のなかで、薫は事件の先に〈おうち〉の存在へと辿り着く。そして晋一の存在によって、その均衡が崩されていく──。
t1651263.synopsis_en: A crime suspense film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Hiroshi Sano, winner of the 66th Edogawa Ranpo Award, starring Riho Yoshioka and Nao in a double lead, set in a shelter where women suffering violence from spouses or parents take refuge. Directed and written by Ryuhei Yoshino of "You Are Younger Than Those Guys Forever." Noriko, who escaped her husband's violence, loses her place and is saved by nurse Michiko, who brings her to "Ouchi," a shelter in a Japanese-style house on the outskirts of Miura Beach. At that place, which shelters women who have suffered violence from spouses or parents, everything in daily life—cooking, cleaning, and so on—is governed by a rule of "taking turns." Noriko regains a peaceful, protected daily life, but gradually begins to feel something off about that routine. And finally, she learns the truth of the organized crime being carried out at "Ouchi." Meanwhile, Detective Kaoru, pursuing a certain case, also begins to see the existence of "Ouchi" emerge in her investigation. Riho Yoshioka, who won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 48th Japan Academy Awards for "Identity," plays Noriko, and Nao, who won the Best Actress award at the 2025 Tokyo Drama Award, plays Detective Kaoru. Jun Fubuki, Jun Miho, Wakana Sakai, First Summer Uika, Emi Satsuki, and other colorful faces play the women of "Ouchi," while Takumi Kitamura, Yoshitaka Hara, and Naoya Shimizu play the figures who threaten the women.
t1651263.tmdb_overview_jp: 吉岡里帆×奈緒 W主演 2026年全国公開映画『シャドウワーク』

nundopicnic4kリマスター.synopsis: アトリエのような住まいで暮らす萌実（山口智子）と由起夫（豊川悦司）。 ある時、萌実は身の回りの物をヒモで縛りつけるという不可解な行動をとるようになる。 ペットの亀を縛り、編み物をする自らの手を縛る萌実を危惧し、萌実を精神科医（田口トモロヲ）のもとへ連れて行く由起夫。診察を受けたところ“強迫性緊縛症候群”の診断を下された。 症状は進行し、萌実はついに目に見えないものまで縛り始めるのだった。
nundopicnic4kリマスター.synopsis_en: Moemi (Tomoko Yamaguchi) and Yukio (Etsushi Toyokawa) live in a home that resembles an artist's atelier. At some point, Moemi begins to engage in the incomprehensible behavior of tying up the things around her with string. Worried about Moemi, who ties up their pet turtle and binds her own hands while knitting, Yukio takes her to a psychiatrist (Tomorowo Taguchi). After an examination, she is diagnosed with "obsessive binding syndrome." The symptoms progress, and Moemi finally begins to bind even things that cannot be seen.

t11257.director: ジェームズ・アイボリー
t11257.synopsis: E・M・フォースター原作の同名小説をイギリスの名匠ジェームズ・アイボリー監督が映画化し、第59回アカデミー賞で脚色賞、美術賞、衣装デザイン賞を受賞した恋愛ドラマ。 まだ封建的な思想が強かった20世紀初頭。フィレンツェを訪れたイギリス名家の令嬢ルーシーは、ホテルの“眺めのいい部屋”を譲ってくれた青年ジョージから情熱的なアプローチを受ける。だが、階級や身分の違いを気にしたルーシーはジョージの思いを受け入れずに、イギリスに帰国。貴族の青年セシルと婚約するが……。 出演はヘレナ・ボナム・カーターのほか、ジュリアン・サンズ、ダニエル・デイ＝ルイス、ルパート・グレイブス、ジュディ・デンチ、マギー・スミスらイギリスを代表する名優たちが顔をそろえた。2012年にデジタルリマスター版でリバイバル。2026年には作品誕生40周年を記念して4Kレストア版でリバイバル公開。
t11257.synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapted from E.M. Forster's novel of the same name by renowned British director James Ivory, which won the Academy Awards for Best Adapted Screenplay, Best Art Direction, and Best Costume Design at the 59th Academy Awards. In the early 20th century, when feudalistic thinking was still strong. Lucy, a young lady from a distinguished English family visiting Florence, receives a passionate approach from a young man named George, who gave up the hotel's 'room with a view' for her. However, conscious of the differences in class and status, Lucy does not accept George's feelings and returns to England. She becomes engaged to Cecil, a young aristocrat, but... The cast includes Helena Bonham Carter, along with Julian Sands, Daniel Day-Lewis, Rupert Graves, Judi Dench, Maggie Smith, and other renowned actors representing British cinema. A digitally remastered version was re-released in 2012. In 2026, a 4K restored version will be re-released to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the film's creation.
t11257.tmdb_overview_en: When Lucy Honeychurch and chaperon Charlotte Bartlett find themselves in Florence with rooms without views, fellow guests Mr Emerson and son George step in to remedy the situation. Meeting the Emersons could change Lucy's life forever but, once back in England, how will her experiences in Tuscany affect her marriage plans?
t11257.tmdb_overview_jp: まだ封建的であった20世紀初頭のイギリス。良家の令嬢ルーシーは、旅先のフィレンツェで労働者階級の青年と出会う。情熱的な彼にルーシーは強く惹かれるが……。格調高い様式美の中で綴られるラヴ・ロマンス。

t687163.movie_title: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
t687163.movie_title_jp: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
t687163.clean_title_jp: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t687163.synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the bestselling science fiction novel by Andy Weir, author of "The Martian" (the basis for the Oscar-nominated "The Martian"). It depicts a middle school science teacher entrusted with the fate of Earth on the brink of extinction, who encounters an unknown life form with the same purpose at the edge of the universe, and together they risk their lives to save their home planets. An unexplained anomaly occurs where the sun's energy is being drained. If this continues, Earth will freeze and humanity will perish. It is discovered that the same phenomenon is happening not only to the sun but to countless stars scattered across the universe, and a single intact star is found 11.9 light-years away. Humanity's only remaining option is to travel to that star in a spaceship and solve the mystery to save the sun and humanity. Sent into space for this "Hail Mary" project is Grace, a brilliant scientist who left academia and now works as a humble middle school teacher. Alone in the vastness of space far from Earth, he relies on his scientific knowledge to tackle the mission, where he meets Rocky, an alien also struggling to save his home planet. Despite their different forms and languages, the two use science as a common language to face challenges, developing a friendship along the way. Ryan Gosling of "La La Land" and "Barbie" plays the protagonist middle school teacher Grace, with Sandra Hüller of "Anatomy of a Fall" and "The Zone of Interest" co-starring. Drew Goddard, who also worked on "The Martian," wrote the screenplay, and Phil Lord & Christopher Miller, known for producing and writing the "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" series, directed.
t687163.tmdb_overview_en: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Saneo and Hajime, captivated by moving pictures and dreaming of "tomorrow," leave Aomori for Tokyo, and by chance begin working at Inokashira Kaikan, the first movie theater in Kichijoji. Older brother Hajime works as a silent film narrator (benshi), while younger brother Saneo struggles as the company president. The two strive to further develop the theater, but...
t1373801.tmdb_overview_en: Two brothers start working as benshi narrators of silent films in a cinema in the early 20th century. This premise is the jumping-off point for an epic family saga that follows the protagonists and their descendants through wars and technological developments.
t1373801.tmdb_overview_jp: 1927年。活動写真に魅了され、“あした”を夢見て青森から上京したサネオとハジメは、ひょんなことから吉祥寺初の映画館・井の頭会館で働き始める。兄・ハジメは活弁士、弟・サネオは社長として奮闘。劇場のさらなる発展を目指す2人だったが…。

t434218.synopsis_en: Jun, a university student living in an apartment near Inokashira Park, has broken up with his girlfriend and been held back a year, spending his days in a rut. One day, when Jun returns to his apartment, a high school girl he has never met, Haru, suddenly comes to visit. Haru, who was trying to write a novel about her deceased father, read letters from her father's former lover Sachiko that he had kept, and came to the room where Jun now lives, which appeared in a photograph. The two begin searching for Sachiko and meet her grandson Tokio.
t434218.tmdb_overview_en: Jun is a university student. She meets high school student Haru. Haru is looking for Sachiko, the ex-girlfriend of her now deceased father. Jun and Haru meet Tokio. Tokio is the grandson of Sachiko and they learn that Sachiko is now deceased. They find an open-reel tape from Sachiko's articles.
t434218.tmdb_overview_jp: 井の頭公園のそばに立つアパートで暮らす大学生の純は恋人と別れ、留年も決定と、うまくいかない日々を過ごしていた。ある日、純がアパートに戻ると、見知らぬ女子高校生のハルが突然訪ねてくる。亡くなった父親についての小説を書こうとしていたハルは、父親が保存していた昔の恋人・佐知子の手紙を読み、写真に写っていた純の住む部屋にやって来たのだった。2人は佐知子のことを捜し始め、彼女の孫トキオと出会う。

t54001.synopsis_en: The feature-length debut of Iranian master Abbas Kiarostami, made in 1974, this human drama freshly depicts the funny yet poignant adventures of a boy struggling desperately to watch a soccer match. Gassem, a 10-year-old boy attending elementary school, is obsessed with soccer, often neglecting his homework and classes, earning constant scolding from his teacher and mother. Determined to go see an important match held in the capital, Tehran, he tries every trick to get money for transportation and a ticket, including stealing from home and deceiving his friends... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
t54001.tmdb_overview_en: Hassan Darabi, a troublesome, amoral 10-year-old boy in a small Iranian town wishes to see the Iran national football team play an important match in Tehran. In order to achieve that, he scams his friends and neighbors.

t1466682.synopsis_en: This biographical drama centers on Fumiko Kaneko, a nihilist and anarchist who fiercely resisted Japan's state power about 100 years ago, depicting the 121 days from her death sentence to her suicide in prison. Directed by female filmmaker Sachi Hamano (known for "Yukiko-san no Ashioto"), the film draws on tanka poems that convey Kaneko's own voice to portray her solitary struggle. Born in 1903, Kaneko grew up as a "non-registered person" because her father never filed her birth registration. At age nine, she was sent to live with her grandmother and aunt in Korea, where she suffered abuse akin to slavery from a family that exploited the colonized Korean villagers. In 1919, she witnessed the March First Independence Movement in Korea. Sent back to her mother's home in Yamanashi at 16, she later struggled through poverty in Tokyo, moving ideologically from Christianity to socialism, anarchism, and finally nihilism. She eventually met Park Yeol, a Korean independence activist who had fled to Japan. Becoming comrades and lovers, they campaigned against Japanese imperialism and colonialism, but were arrested during the 1923 Great Kanto Earthquake and sentenced to death. After her sentence was commuted to life imprisonment through amnesty, Kaneko was sent to Tochigi Women's Prison, where she continued her solitary fight behind bars. Nanana stars as Kaneko, embodying the soulful cry of a woman who defied state power to the end. Katsuya Kobayashi plays Park Yeol, with supporting performances by Masaki Miura, Yoko Horaguchi, and Kazuko Yoshiyuki.
t1466682.tmdb_overview_en: Why did she die? The Supreme Court first sentenced her to death, but then commuted her sentence to life imprisonment and sent her to Tochigi Women's Prison. What happened before she took her own life there? Based on her tanka poems, which convey her raw voice, the film explores her lone fight during the 121 days between her death sentence and suicide, a period that has remained obscure to date.
t1466682.tmdb_overview_jp: 金子文子はなぜ死んだのか。大審院で死刑判決を受けた後、無期懲役に減刑され、栃木女子刑務所に送られた。自死するまで何があったのか。本映画では文子のナマの声を伝える短歌をもとに、これまで空白であった死刑判決から自死に至る121日間の、文子のたったひとりの闘いを描きます。

n雌鶏.synopsis: ストーリー 養鶏場で生まれ育った1 羽の雌鶏が、出荷用トラックから脱走！人生初の自由を手に入れた彼女は、刺激と危険に満ちた世界を走り抜け、ワケあり一家が暮らす家へと辿り着く。庭に建つニワトリ小屋で新生活を送るなか、初恋を知り、初めて産んだ卵を温め育てようと決意する。ところが大切な卵は毎日人間に回収されてしまう過酷な現実に直面。人生とは？生きるとは？雌鶏は我が子がヒヨコになる日を夢見る一方、飼い主一家はとある事件に巻き込まれる。そこには両者にとって思いがけない運命が待ち受けていた――。
n雌鶏.synopsis_en: A hen born and raised on a poultry farm escapes from a shipping truck! Having gained freedom for the first time in her life, she runs through a world full of excitement and danger, eventually arriving at a house where a family with complications lives. While living a new life in a chicken coop in the garden, she experiences first love and decides to incubate and raise the first egg she lays. However, she faces the harsh reality that her precious eggs are collected by humans every day. What is life? What is living? While the hen dreams of the day her children become chicks, the owner family gets caught up in a certain incident. An unexpected fate awaits them both——

nばなにゃ第1期全13話一挙上映.synopsis:
【概要】 『ばなにゃ』はファンシー文具メーカー、株式会社クーリア原案のキャラクターをアニメ化し、2016年にTVシリーズアニメーションとして放送。TVシリーズは第2期まで、配信シリーズとして第3期が制作されており、2026年7月には10周年記念作品として『ばなにゃ あっとほーむぱーてぃー』が各配信サイトにて配信されました。 世界的高級ブランドとのコラボ実績もあるなど海外でも大人気の本作。今後も、タイアップ企画やイベントが続々と予定されています。 声優にはシリーズを通して梶裕貴・村瀬歩を起用、今回上映される第1期では蛭子能収がナレーターを務めています。ばなにゃの可愛らしい鳴き声（？）はもちろん、"ばなにゃ研究者"という設定でばなにゃの生態を紹介する、淡々とした優しく穏やかなナレーションも必聴です。 バナナの中にひそむ不思議な生物、ばなにゃ。映画館という特別な場所で日常を離れて、可愛いばなにゃ達にぜひ癒されてください。 【ばなにゃ　とは？】 バナナの中にひそむ不思議なにゃんこ。 バナナの皮に包まれている部分は誰も見た事がない... 本物のバナナにまぎれて暮らしていて、人がいない時に こっそり遊んだり、いたずらしたりするよ。 甘いお菓子と遊ぶことが大好き♥ 夢はおしゃれな「チョコばなにゃ」になることだよ。 【上映期間】 2026年9月25日（金）～10月1日（木）　1週間限定　※1日1回上映 【料金】 特別料金1000円均一 ※各種招待券、無料券使用不可 【上映時間】 計43分　（1話3分20秒）

nばなにゃ第1期全13話一挙上映.synopsis_en: [Overview] "Bananya" is an anime adaptation of characters originally created by fancy stationery maker Q-Lia Co., Ltd., broadcast as a TV series anime in 2016. The TV series ran through Season 2, and Season 3 was produced as a streaming series. In July 2026, as a 10th anniversary work, "Bananya: At Home Party" was distributed on various streaming sites. This work is hugely popular overseas as well, with collaborations with world-class luxury brands. More tie-in projects and events are planned going forward. Yuki Kaji and Ayumu Murase have been cast throughout the series, and in Season 1 being screened this time, Yoshikazu Ebisu serves as narrator. Of course you can enjoy Bananya's adorable cries (?), but the calm, gentle, and peaceful narration—introducing Bananya's ecology under the setting of a "Bananya researcher"—is also a must-hear. Bananya: mysterious creatures hiding inside bananas. Please leave your daily life behind in the special place that is a movie theater, and let the cute Bananyas heal you. [What is Bananya?] A mysterious kitty hiding inside a banana. No one has ever seen the part wrapped in the banana peel... They live mixed in with real bananas, and when people aren't around, they secretly play and cause mischief. They love playing with sweet treats♥ Their dream is to become a stylish "Choco Bananya."
