t926606.director: ジェームズ・デモナコ（『パージ』シリーズ）
t926606.synopsis: 全米TOP10入り！『パージ』監督最新作。立ち入り禁止のサイコホラー解禁！ 養兄弟のルークを突然亡くし、悲しみの底で不良行為を繰り返していたグラフィティ・アーティストのマックスは老人ホームの清掃員として働くことで刑務所行きを免れた。 マックスが配属されたのはニューヨーク州北部の深い森にひっそりと佇む穏やかな老人ホーム「グリーン・メドウズ」。 優しい入居者たちに囲まれて、やりがいを感じはじめる彼だったが、夜中に響く悲鳴、入居者の突然の死、そして"特別なケア"が必要とされる入居者が暮らす4階への立ち入りを禁止されたことから不信感を抱き、潜入を試みるのだが......。
t926606.synopsis_en: Top 10 in the US! The latest film from the director of "The Purge." A forbidden psycho-horror unleashed! Graffiti artist Max, who lost her foster brother Luke suddenly and had been acting out in the depths of grief, avoided a prison sentence by working as a cleaner at a nursing home. Max was assigned to "Green Meadows," a peaceful nursing home quietly nestled in the deep woods of upstate New York. Surrounded by gentle residents, she begins to feel a sense of purpose, but she grows suspicious due to screams echoing in the night, the sudden deaths of residents, and being forbidden from entering the fourth floor where residents requiring "special care" live, so she attempts to sneak in, but...
t926606.tmdb_overview_en: A troubled man starts working at a retirement home and realizes its residents and caretakers harbor sinister secrets. As he investigates the building and its forbidden fourth floor, he starts to uncover connections to his own past and upbringing as a foster child.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t1496928.synopsis: 「ピーピロリロリロ。地球での極秘任務完了。宇宙へ帰還します！」 平成のある田舎町 内気で"普通"であることに悩む少年・翼は、 小学三年生の春、 クラスの人気者で"特別"な存在の暁太郎と出会い、親友になる 二人だけの遊び、意味のない会話、夕暮れの帰り道------ 世界は確かに、彼らのものだった しかしある日を境に、暁太郎はクラスの中で浮いた存在となり、 噂や視線が彼を囲んでいく やがて起こる、取り返しのつかない事件 「もしもさ、俺が宇宙人だったらどうする？」 これは二人の青春物語なのか それとも消したい記憶なのか 30年にわたる友情を描いた、 かぎりなく青い旅立ちの物語------
t1496928.synopsis_en: "Pipiro rirori ro. Secret mission on Earth complete. Returning to space!" In a certain rural town in the Heisei era, Tsubasa, a shy boy troubled by being "ordinary," meets Akitaro, the class idol and a "special" presence, in the spring of his third year of elementary school, and they become best friends. Games just for the two of them, meaningless conversations, the walk home at dusk—— The world was certainly theirs. But from a certain day onward, Akitaro became an outcast in the class, and rumors and stares surrounded him. Eventually, an irreversible incident occurs. "Hey, what would you do if I were an alien?" Is this a coming-of-age story of two people, or a memory they want to erase? A story of a friendship spanning 30 years, an endlessly blue tale of departure——
t1496928.tmdb_overview_en: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.
t1496928.tmdb_overview_jp: 小学三年生の夏、内気な少年のつばさは、クラスの人気者である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。小さな世界の中で、かけがえのない時間を過ごしていくふたり。しかし、ある些細な事件をきっかけに、ふたりの関係は引き裂かれて——。  30年以上にわたる少年たちの友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかける物語。

t1448971.synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.
t1448971.tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
t1448971.tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。

t1264805.synopsis: ひと組の男女の忘れられない恋と人生の選択を描いた韓国のラブストーリー。 不器用だが誠実な工学部生ウノと、厳しい現実の中で建築家を目指すジョンウォン。それぞれの夢を胸に地方からソウルへ上京したふたりは、激しく愛し合いながらも別れる道を選んだ。10年ぶりに偶然の再会を果たした彼らは、青春時代を輝かせた思い出をたどっていく。 ドラマ「寄生獣　ザ・グレイ」や映画「脱走」などに出演するク・ギョファンがウノ役、テレビドラマ「女神降臨」の主人公役で注目を集めたムン・ガヨンがジョンウォン役でそれぞれ主演を務め、20代前半から30代のふたりを繊細かつリアルに演じる。「82年生まれ、キム・ジヨン」のキム・ドヨン監督がメガホンをとった。
t1264805.synopsis_en: Summer 2008, Seoul. University students Uno and Jeong-won meet fatefully on a long-distance bus. Uno, who dreams of becoming a game creator, and Jeong-won, who aspires to be an architect. Supporting each other through their urban days filled with dreams and anxieties, they eventually fall in love, deeply and truly. However, faced with the harshness of reality that youth cannot resist, they choose to part ways. Ten years later, in the summer of 2024, they coincidentally reunite on a flight to Seoul. As they look back on their memories, Uno asks Jeong-won a question he has kept buried deep in his heart: 'What if, back then...'
t1264805.tmdb_overview_en: Seoul, 2008. On a bus heading to their hometown, fate brings Eun-ho and Jeong-won together, sparking an unlikely friendship. While battling  a bustling and weary city life, they find themselves sharing lofty dreams and a love that comes to feel extraordinary. But, eventually, the harsh realities of life lead them to part ways. Over a decade after the separation, the two unexpectedly reunite on a flight back to Korea, where they reflect on their lost time.
t1264805.tmdb_overview_jp: 地方からソウルへ上京し夢を抱く二人。かつて激しく愛し合い別れたウノとジョンウォンが、10年ぶりの偶然の再会をきっかけに思い出をたどる。

t1661276.synopsis: 「君の名は。」「すずめの戸締まり」などのコミックス・ウェーブ・フィルムが見いだした新鋭・片野坂亮監督が描く短編アニメーション映画。 1996年、夏の終わり。熊本の海辺の町に父と2人で暮らす10歳の少年・湊は、酒に溺れる父のもとで息を潜めるように生きていた。そんな彼にとって唯一の心の拠りどころは、弁天島に現れる少女の神さま・べんちゃんで、彼女と過ごすひとときだけが自分を取り戻せる時間だった。しかし湊は児童養護施設に入所することになり、べんちゃんとの別れの時が迫る。ひとつだけ願いをかなえてくれるという、海に浮かぶ不思議な光「しらぬひ」に祈りを捧げる湊だったが、父への憎しみが募るにつれ、その祈りは取り返しのつかない呪いへと姿を変えていく。 主人公・湊の声をあのが務め、声優の花澤香菜、三木眞一郎が共演。スーパーの鮮魚コーナーで働きながらフリーの映像作家として実写映画やアニメーション作品を自主制作してきた片野坂亮監督が商業アニメーション映画に初挑戦し、コミックス・ウェーブ・フィルムがアニメーション制作を担った。テレビ「ユーリ!!! on ICE」などで知られる作曲家・編曲家の梅林太郎が音楽、シンガーソングライターの青葉市子が主題歌を担当。
t1661276.synopsis_en: A short animated film from director Ryo Katano, a new talent discovered by CoMix Wave Films, the studio behind 'Your Name.' and 'Suzume.' It is the end of summer in 1996. Ten-year-old Minato, who lives with his father in a seaside town in Kumamoto, has been living quietly, holding his breath under a father drowning in alcohol. His only emotional anchor is Benchan, a girl who appears on Bentenjima and is revered as a goddess, and the time he spends with her is the only moments he can feel like himself again. But Minato is set to enter a children's home, and the time of farewell with Benchan draws near. Minato prays to 'Shiranui,' a mysterious light floating on the sea said to grant one wish, but as his hatred for his father grows, that prayer transforms into an irreversible curse. The protagonist Minato is voiced by Ano, with voice actors Kana Hanazawa and Shinichiro Miki co-starring. Director Ryo Katano, who has worked at a supermarket's fresh fish section while independently producing live-action films and animated works as a freelance filmmaker, makes his first attempt at a commercial animated film, with CoMix Wave Films handling animation production. Taro Umebayashi, known for the TV series 'Yuri!!! on ICE' among others, handles the music, and singer-songwriter Ichiko Aoba performs the theme song.
t1661276.tmdb_overview_en: Summer 1996 – Minato, a 10-year-old boy, is neglected by his alcoholic father and keeps to himself at home in a town by the sea. His only source of solace is Ben-chan, a girl goddess that appears on Benten Island. As Minato faces a new life in an orphanage and a painful parting from Ben-chan, he makes a wish to Shiranui for her. However, growing hatred toward his father gradually turns the wish into a malicious "curse" against him…

t46986.synopsis: 「愛・アマチュア」のハル・ハートリーが同じシチュエーションで始まる物語を、ニューヨーク、ベルリン、東京の3つの都市を舞台にそれぞれ描いた実験的オムニバス作品。ニューヨークに暮らす青年ビルの恋人エミリーが仕事で外国に行くことになる。遠距離恋愛を続ける自信がないビルはエミリーにプロポーズするか、それとも別の女性のもとにいくべきか迷っていた。そしてベルリンに住むドワイト、東京で女優をしている美穂もまた、同じように外国へ行く恋人との関係を続けるか、別の誰かを選ぶかで思い悩むが。同じシチュエーションで始まった物語は、それぞれの登場人物によって異なる方向へ展開していく。東京編には後にハートリー監督の妻となる二階堂美穂が主演。永瀬正敏や松重豊らが共演している。
t46986.synopsis_en: An experimental omnibus work by Hal Hartley of 'The Unbelievable Truth,' depicting stories that begin with the same situation, set in three cities: New York, Berlin, and Tokyo. In New York, Bill's girlfriend Emily is going abroad for work. Bill, who lacks confidence in maintaining a long-distance relationship, is torn between proposing to Emily or going to another woman. Meanwhile, Dwight in Berlin and Miho, an actress in Tokyo, also agonize over whether to continue their relationships with partners going abroad or choose someone else. The stories that begin with the same situation unfold in different directions depending on the characters. The Tokyo segment stars Miho Nikaido, who later became Hartley's wife, with Masatoshi Nagase and Yutaka Matsushige co-starring.
t46986.tmdb_overview_en: The same situation is played out in different cities (New York, Berlin and Tokyo). A lover has to choose whether to commit to a partner who is returning home. In each case there are other people involved, an ex-partner and someone else in a "permanent" relationship, what do they choose to do?

n京都京都文化博物館祇園祭密談長屋.movie_title_jp: 【京都：京都文化博物館】祇園祭／密談長屋
n京都京都文化博物館祇園祭密談長屋.synopsis: 応仁の乱後の荒廃した京都を舞台に、京町衆が武士階級に対抗して自らの手で町を守り、祇園祭の復興に挑む姿を描いた壮大な時代劇。圧巻の山鉾巡行シーンは、エキストラ1万人以上の群衆が参加して撮影が敢行された。
n京都京都文化博物館祇園祭密談長屋.synopsis_en: Set in Kyoto devastated after the Ōnin War, this grand period drama depicts the townspeople of Kyoto rising against the samurai class to protect their city with their own hands and take on the challenge of reviving the Gion Festival. The breathtaking float procession scenes were filmed with over 10,000 extras participating.

t37836.tmdb_overview_en: At the identification of a dead body, a couple and a morgue employee both claim to be related to the deceased, and therefore the rightful recipient of an indemnity of at least 520,000.

t43001.director: セルジュ・ブールギニョン
t43001.synopsis_en: The tragic story of a young orphan girl who develops a friendship with a French Indochina War veteran—a pure but emotionally troubled man.
t43001.tmdb_overview_en: The tragic story of a young orphan girl who is befriended by an innocent but emotionally disabled veteran of the French Indochina War.
t43001.tmdb_overview_jp: フランス領インドシナ戦争の退役軍人で、純粋だが感情的に問題を抱えた男性と友情を育む、幼い孤児の少女の悲劇的な物語。

t674813.movie_title: 幻愛　夢の向こうに
t674813.movie_title_jp: 幻愛　夢の向こうに
t674813.synopsis: 「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」のテレンス・ラウとセシリア・チョイが共演し、現実と幻の境界をさまよう男女の切ない愛を描いたラブストーリー。 小学校教師のレイ・ジーロックは、統合失調症を患いながらも、どうにか日常生活を送っていた。彼は偶然出会った女性ヤンヤンに一目ぼれし、仲を深めていくが、自身の病について打ち明けることができない。その間に症状は悪化していき、やがてヤンヤンそのものがジーロックの幻覚だったことが判明。ジーロックは治療のためのセラピーの場で、ヤンヤンに瓜二つの女性イップ・ラムと出会う。彼女は心理学を専攻する大学院生で、統合失調症の症状のひとつである「恋愛妄想」を研究していた。理想的な研究対象であるロックに論文執筆の協力を依頼するラムだったが、いつしか2人は研究者と患者の立場を超える感情を抱くようになる。 監督は「十年」「時代革命」のキウィ・チョウ。統合失調症に苦しみながらも愛を求めようとする青年ジーロックをテレンス・ラウ、彼が恋に落ちるヤンヤンとラムをセシリア・チョイが演じ、第26回香港電影評論學會大奨で最優秀男優賞と最優秀女優賞をそれぞれ受賞した。
t674813.synopsis_en:
Terence Lau (*Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In*) and Cecilia Choi star in this poignant love story depicting a man and woman wandering the boundary between reality and illusion.

Primary school teacher Lai Chi-lok manages to lead a functional life despite suffering from schizophrenia. He falls in love at first sight with a woman named Yan Yan, but as they grow closer, he is unable to confess his illness to her. As his symptoms worsen, it is eventually revealed that Yan Yan herself was a hallucination. During a therapy session, Lok meets Ip Lam, a woman who is the spitting image of Yan Yan. A graduate student majoring in psychology, Lam is researching "erotomania," a symptom of schizophrenia. Though she initially asks Lok to cooperate with her thesis as an ideal research subject, the two soon develop feelings that transcend the roles of researcher and patient.

The film is directed by Kiwi Chow (*Ten Years*, *Revolution of Our Times*). Terence Lau plays Chi-lok, a young man seeking love while struggling with schizophrenia, and Cecilia Choi plays both Yan Yan and Lam. Their performances won Best Actor and Best Actress, respectively, at the 26th Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards.
t674813.tmdb_overview_en: Lok is a recovering schizophrenic who yearns for love. One day, he encounters the young and beautiful Yan and quickly falls in love with her. The pair develops a relationship that is beyond their wildest dreams.

t1095805.movie_title: スタントマン　武替道
t1095805.movie_title_jp: スタントマン　武替道
t1095805.clean_title_jp: スタントマン 武替道
t1095805.synopsis: 香港アクション映画界の現場に欠くことのできないスタントマンたちに焦点を当て、仕事と夢に情熱を注ぐスタントマンたちの姿を描いたドラマ。日本でも人気を集めた「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」のテレンス・ラウとフィリップ・ンが出演。 1980年代、売れっ子アクション監督として活躍していたサムは、撮影中に危険なアクションシーンを強行したことでスタントマンを半身不随にしてしまい、映画業界を引退する。時は流れ、整骨院を営み静かに暮らしていたサムのもとに、かつての仲間から「もう一度アクション映画の監督をやってほしい」という依頼が舞い込み、数十年ぶりに映画制作に参加する。しかし、アクション映画の現場は、かつてとは異なりコンプライアンスも厳しく、リアリティを追求するサムのやり方に俳優のワイや製作陣が反発し、現場はぎくしゃくする。若手スタントマンのロンは、サムを献身的にフォローし何とか撮影を進めようとするが……。 サム役を、「ツイン・ドラゴン」など数々の作品でアクション指導を務め、「燃えよドラゴン」などに出演もした香港アクション映画界のレジェンド、トン・ワイが演じた。若手スタントマンのロン役をテレンス・ラウ、人気アクション俳優のワイ役をフィリップ・ンがそれぞれ担当。監督は双子のアクション俳優として活躍し、本作が初監督となるアルバート・レオンとハーバート・レオン。タイトルの「武替道（ぶたいどう）」は中国語で「スタントの道」の意味。
t1095805.synopsis_en: In the 1980s, Sam was active as a sought-after action director, but after forcing a dangerous action scene during filming that left a stuntman paralyzed, he retired from the film industry. Years later, Sam, now quietly running an osteopathic clinic, receives a request from former colleagues to "direct an action movie once more," and he joins a film production for the first time in decades. However, the action film set is different from before, with strict compliance rules, and Sam's approach of pursuing realism clashes with the actor Wai and the production team, making the set tense. Young stuntman Ron devotedly supports Sam and tries to keep the shoot going, but...
t1095805.tmdb_overview_en: A washed-up action choreographer, struggling to find his way in a changing industry, risks everything to stage an epic comeback, and attempts to repair the relationship with his estranged daughter before it's too late.
t1095805.tmdb_overview_jp: 1980年代、売れっ子アクション監督として活躍していたサムは、撮影中に危険なアクションシーンを強行したことでスタントマンを半身不随にしてしまい、映画業界を引退する。時は流れ、整骨院を営み静かに暮らしていたサムのもとに、かつての仲間から「もう一度アクション映画の監督をやってほしい」という依頼が舞い込み、数十年ぶりに映画制作に参加する。しかし、アクション映画の現場は、かつてとは異なりコンプライアンスも厳しく、リアリティを追求するサムのやり方に俳優のワイや製作陣が反発し、現場はぎくしゃくする。若手スタントマンのロンは、サムを献身的にフォローし何とか撮影を進めようとするが……。

n偏向報道.synopsis: 「池島譚歌」「私の骨 MY BLOOD BONE」の荻野欣士郎が監督・脚本を手がけ、テレビ局などの報道機関が特定の立場や意図に基づいて情報を編集・強調することで受け手の考えを誘導する「偏向報道」をテーマに制作した社会派ドラマ。かつてテレビ番組制作ディレクターとして報道に携わった経験をもつ荻野監督が、自身の体験した風通しの悪い縦社会を舞台に、下請け制作会社のディレクターがテレビ局上層部の悪習に立ち向かう姿を描き出す。 地方都市のテレビ局・テレビトップの下請け制作会社に所属する、はっきりとものを言う性格のディレクター・油神鈴子。ある時、テレビ局の子会社が、知事のパワハラに関する真偽不明な情報をもとにねつ造映像を制作する。鈴子はその映像の放送を差し止めてほしいと頼まれるが……。 俳優としても活躍するお笑いタレントの鳥居みゆきが油神鈴子役で主演を務め、権力で子会社や下請け会社を威圧する報道局長役で誠直也が共演。東さや香、大迫一平、時東ぁみ、郷田ほづみ、小野進也、螢雪次朗ら個性豊かな俳優陣が脇を固める。
n偏向報道.synopsis_en: A social drama directed and written by Kinshirō Ogino ('Ikushima Tanga,' 'My Bone MY BLOOD BONE'), focusing on 'biased reporting'—how news organizations edit and emphasize information based on specific stances or intentions to sway public opinion. Drawing from his own experience as a TV program director, Ogino depicts a rigid, top-down society where a director at a subcontracting production company confronts the corrupt practices of TV network executives. Suzuko Aburakami, a blunt-speaking director working for a subcontractor of the local TV station 'TV Top,' is asked to stop the broadcast of a fabricated video produced by the network's subsidiary, based on dubious information about the governor's harassment. Comedian and actress Miyuki Torii stars as Suzuko, with Seiya Makoto as the news director who intimidates subsidiaries and subcontractors. The cast includes Sayaka Higashi, Ippei Ōsako, Ami Tokitō, Hozumi Gōda, Shinya Ono, and Setsujirō Hotaru.

t758866.movie_title_jp: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.clean_title_jp: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.movie_title_original: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.synopsis: 村上春樹の短編小説集「女のいない男たち」に収録された短編「ドライブ・マイ・カー」を、「偶然と想像」でベルリン国際映画祭銀熊賞を受賞した濱口竜介監督・脚本により映画化。舞台俳優で演出家の家福悠介は、脚本家の妻・音と幸せに暮らしていた。しかし、妻はある秘密を残したまま他界してしまう。2年後、喪失感を抱えながら生きていた彼は、演劇祭で演出を担当することになり、愛車のサーブで広島へ向かう。そこで出会った寡黙な専属ドライバーのみさきと過ごす中で、家福はそれまで目を背けていたあることに気づかされていく。主人公・家福を西島秀俊、ヒロインのみさきを三浦透子、物語の鍵を握る俳優・高槻を岡田将生、家福の亡き妻・音を霧島れいかがそれぞれ演じる。2021年・第74回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、日本映画では初となる脚本賞を受賞したほか、国際映画批評家連盟賞、AFCAE賞、エキュメニカル審査員賞の3つの独立賞も受賞。また、2022年・第94回アカデミー賞では日本映画史上初となる作品賞にノミネートされる快挙を成し遂げたほか、監督賞、脚色賞、国際長編映画賞とあわせて4部門でノミネート。日本映画としては「おくりびと」以来13年ぶりに国際長編映画賞（旧外国語映画賞）を受賞した。そのほか、第79回ゴールデングローブ賞の最優秀非英語映画賞受賞や、アジア人男性初の全米批評家協会賞主演男優賞受賞など全米の各映画賞でも大きく注目を集めた。日本アカデミー賞でも最優秀作品賞はじめ、計8冠に輝いた。
t758866.synopsis_en: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
t758866.tmdb_overview_en: Yusuke Kafuku, a stage actor and director, still unable, after two years, to cope with the loss of his beloved wife, accepts to direct Uncle Vanya at a theater festival in Hiroshima. There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.
t758866.tmdb_overview_jp: 舞台俳優であり、演出家の家福悠介。彼は、脚本家の妻・音と満ち足りた日々を送っていた。しかし、妻はある秘密を残したまま突然この世からいなくなってしまう――。２年後、演劇祭で演出を任されることになった家福は、愛車のサーブで広島へと向かう。そこで出会ったのは、寡黙な専属ドライバーみさきだった。喪失感を抱えたまま生きる家福は、みさきと過ごすなか、それまで目を背けていたあることに気づかされていく…

n女と味噌汁デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: . 新宿の芸者・てまり(池内淳子)の夢は、得意の味噌汁を売りにした店を出すこと。お座敷の客・桐谷(佐藤英夫)との不貞がばれて、その妻が家に乗り込んでくるが、口論の末2人は打ちとけてしまう。石井のアイデアでバナナを食べながら化粧をした長山藍子や、芸者どうしの殴り合いシーンなど、強い女性たちの活躍は時をこえて痛快で美しい。 . .
n女と味噌汁デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: Temari (Junko Ikeuchi), a geisha in Shinjuku, dreams of opening a restaurant featuring her specialty: miso soup. When her affair with a client, Kiritani (Hideo Sato), is discovered, his wife storms into her home — but after a heated argument, the two women end up bonding. With Ishii's ideas throughout — such as Aiko Nagayama eating a banana while applying makeup, or a scene of geisha fighting one another — the exploits of these strong women remain exhilarating and beautiful across the years.

n愛と死をみつめて前篇デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: 十代で難病を患ったみち子(大空眞弓)と、遠距離でもひたむきに彼女を愛する大学生・実(山本学)の悲恋。「手術で顔の半分を切除するくらいなら死にたい」と言うみち子に、実は無償の愛を捧げて手術を決意させる。橋田が書いた台本は電話帳くらい分厚かったが、「カットしたくない」と言う橋田の想いを受け、石井は「東芝日曜劇場」において初の前後編を決意した。 . .
n愛と死をみつめて前篇デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: A tragic love story between Michiko (Mayumi Ozora), who fell gravely ill in her teens, and Minoru (Manabu Yamamoto), a university student who loves her devotedly despite the distance between them. When Michiko says, "If it means having half my face removed in surgery, I'd rather die," Minoru offers her selfless love and persuades her to go through with the operation. The script written by Hashida was as thick as a phone book, but moved by Hashida's desire not to cut anything, Ishii decided to make it the first-ever two-part installment of "Toshiba Sunday Theater."

t1356587.synopsis_en:
Chang’an, the capital of the Tang Dynasty. Li Shande, a low-ranking official, receives a life-altering command from the Emperor: “Deliver fresh lychees from the far southern region of Lingnan to Chang’an to celebrate the birthday of Consort Yang.” Lychees are notoriously perishable, making it nearly impossible to transport them thousands of kilometers from Lingnan to Chang’an without spoiling. Success means a path to promotion, but failure means certain death.

Tricked into the impossible role of “Lychee Envoy” by a colleague’s scheme, Li Shande heads to Lingnan. There, he joins forces with an unlikely group of allies, including the daughter of a lychee orchard master, a merchant investing in the plan, and a young man oppressed as a slave. With the deadline looming, the fruit rotting, and the murky power struggles of the imperial court swirling around him, Li Shande faces overwhelming odds. Now, an unprecedented “Lychee Transport Mission” that will shake the course of history is about to begin!
t1356587.tmdb_overview_en: During the Tianbao period of the Tang Dynasty, Li Shande, a petty official in Chang'an, was suddenly given a task to bring fresh lychees from Lingnan. The lychee is perishable, and becomes tasteless three days after it leaves the branch, and Lingnan is more than 5,000 miles away from Chang'an, so this is an impossible task. But for the sake of his wife and daughter at home, Li Shande was determined to give it a try.

t690.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t690.synopsis_en: Michel, a poor university student, discovers by chance that he has a talent for pickpocketing. Though once caught by a detective, he is released due to lack of evidence and soon targets others' wallets again. Eventually, his methods become organized as he brings in accomplices. In 'A Man Escaped,' Bresson realistically and thrillingly depicted a prison break; here, he turns his focus to pickpocketing, introducing actual techniques while portraying a lonely young man distrustful of others. A gripping masterpiece where the realism born from amateur actors and the suspense created by various pickpocketing scenes blend seamlessly.
t690.tmdb_overview_en: Michel takes up pickpocketing on a lark and is arrested soon after. His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.
t690.tmdb_overview_jp: 貧しい大学生ミシェルは、ふとしたきっかけで、自分にスリの才能があることを発見する。一度は刑事に捕まったものの、証拠不十分で釈放されるや、再び他人の財布を狙い出す。やがてその手口は、仲間を引き込んだ組織的なものになっていった……。「抵抗」では“脱獄”をリアルにスリリングに描いたＲ・ブレッソンが、今度はその焦点を“スリ”に当てた作品で、実際の手口を紹介しながら、人間不信の孤独な青年の姿を描く。素人ばかりの出演者から生まれるリアリティと、様々なスリの描写によって生み出されるサスペンスが混然となった迫真の傑作だ。

n映画しびれトークイベント付.movie_title: 映画『しびれ』トークイベント付
n映画しびれトークイベント付.movie_title_jp: 映画『しびれ』トークイベント付
n映画しびれトークイベント付.synopsis: 日本海沿いの町に暮らす少年、大地は、幼少期に暴君のようだった父の影響から言葉を発しない。今は母の亜樹と暮らしているが、夜の仕事で生計を立てざるを得ない亜樹はほとんど家に帰らず、生活は苦しい。やがて亜樹と共に叔母の家に身を寄せるが、どこにも居場所はなく、ひとりで過ごしては内気になっていった。大地は父の行方を求めて生家を訪ねることを決意。これを境に、彼の運命は大きく揺らいでいく———。心のよるべなき貧困、誰にも見つからぬように生きる孤独の中のささやかな救い、母への複雑な感情。流されるままに生きているようで、歩みを止めない大地。そんな彼がかすかな光を手繰り寄せ、息をのむような大きな愛を知るまでの20年間が、少年の姿を追い続け、リアリズムに根ざした視点で綴られていく。
n映画しびれトークイベント付.synopsis_en: Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, has been unable to speak since childhood due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant. He now lives with his mother Aki, but she is forced to make a living through night work and is rarely home, making their life difficult. Eventually, they take shelter at his aunt's house, but he finds no place to belong anywhere, and as he spends time alone, he grows increasingly introverted. Daichi decides to visit his childhood home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken. Poverty with no emotional anchor, small comforts amid the loneliness of living unseen by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi appears to drift through life, yet never stops moving forward. The twenty years until he grasps at a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are chronicled through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's journey.

t1422637.director: ユナイテッドピープル
t1422637.tmdb_overview_en: Dear Tomorrow is a multi-character story about loneliness. Set in Japan, the film centers around the mental health hotline called “A Place for You”, where a group of young volunteers are chatting with thousands in need, every single day.

t16646.movie_title: エルミタージュ幻想 ＜アレクサンドル・ソクーロフ特集＞
t16646.synopsis_en: Russian master Alexander Sokurov presents this 2002 work set in the world heritage site, the Hermitage Museum. Created with a single 90-minute continuous shot, a first in film history, it depicts a time travel where past and present intertwine. Guided by the narration of the 19th-century French diplomat, the Marquis de Custine, and Sokurov himself, the film journeys through the interior of Russia's pride, the Hermitage Museum. Within the halls lined with masterpieces by Raphael, da Vinci, Rembrandt, and El Greco, 300 years of Russian history unfold. They encounter historical figures—sometimes Peter the Great, sometimes Catherine the Great at the theater, sometimes the last supper of Nicholas II as revolution looms. Using the museum interior with its artworks still on display as the stage, the movements of actors and crowds are unified to depict 300 years of Russian history in a single continuous image. Conductor Valery Gergiev makes a special appearance, with music performed by the Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra. The film caused a stir when it was first released in Japanese theaters in 2003, and a digitally remastered version is set for re-release in September 2026.
t16646.tmdb_overview_en: A ghost and a French marquis wander through the Winter Palace in St Petersburg, encountering scenes from many different periods of its history.

t175041.movie_title: 桐島、部活やめるってよ
t175041.movie_title_jp: 桐島、部活やめるってよ
t175041.clean_title_jp: 桐島、部活やめるってよ
t175041.movie_title_original: 桐島、部活やめるってよ
t175041.synopsis_en: Ryoya Maeda belongs to the film club at a prefectural high school in a rural town. Though he is plain and inconspicuous in class, his passion for film is stronger than anyone else's. The students at his school go about their daily lives—some diligently participating in club activities on Friday afternoons as usual, while others with time on their hands play basketball as members of the go-home club. One day, Kirishima, the captain of the most popular volleyball team in school, quits the club. This triggers a wave of unease that begins to spread through the relationships among the various clubs and classmates.
t175041.tmdb_overview_en: A story about the disappearance of Kirishima, a star athlete of the volleyball club, and how his disappearance affects every person in school.
t175041.tmdb_overview_jp: とある田舎町の県立高校映画部に所属する前田涼也は、クラスの中では地味で目立たないものの、映画に対する情熱が人一倍強い人物だった。そんな彼の学校の生徒たちは、金曜日の放課後、いつもと変わらず部活に励み、一方暇を持て余す帰宅部がバスケに興じるなど、それぞれの日常を過ごしていた。ある日、学校で一番人気があるバレー部のキャプテン桐島が退部。それをきっかけに、各部やクラスの人間関係に動揺が広がり始めていく。

t49964.synopsis_en: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
t49964.tmdb_overview_en: An 8-year-old boy must return his friend's notebook he took by mistake, lest his friend be punished by expulsion from school.
t49964.tmdb_overview_jp: 間違って友だちのノートを持ち帰ってしまった少年が、ノートを返そうと隣村へと走る! キアロスタミ監督の名を世界的なものにした作品で、通称“ジグザグ道3部作”と呼ばれる作品の第1作。

t1403864.movie_title: 早乙女カナコの場合は
t1403864.movie_title_jp: 早乙女カナコの場合は
t1403864.clean_title_jp: 早乙女カナコの場合は
t1403864.movie_title_original: 早乙女カナコの場合は
t1403864.synopsis_en: Kanako Saotome begins living with a friend when she enters university. At the entrance ceremony, she meets Nagatsuda, an aspiring screenwriter in the theater circle "Charing Cross," and they start dating. She finishes job hunting and lands a position at the major publishing company she had dreamed of. She and Nagatsuda have been together for four years, but lately they argue constantly. Nagatsuda only talks big, never finishes writing a script, and shows no intention of graduating. There are even suspicions that he is cheating with Maiko, a first-year student from a women's university who joined the circle. Just then, Kanako receives a confession from Yoshizawa, a senior colleague at her future employer. As Kanako pursues her dream of becoming an editor, she and Nagatsuda gradually drift apart in their ways of life.
t1403864.tmdb_overview_en: Kanako, a college senior, is torn between her unreliable ex Keishi and her steady new admirer Yoichi. As Keishi grows close to a freshman named Maiko, and Yoichi’s ex Aiko moves on, Kanako must decide what—and who—she really wants.
t1403864.tmdb_overview_jp: 大学進学と同時に友達と二人暮らしを始めた早乙女カナコ。入学式で演劇サークル「チャリングクロス」で脚本家を目指す長津田と出会い、そのまま付き合うことに。就職活動を終え、念願の大手出版社に就職が決まる。長津田とも４年の付き合いになるが、このところ口げんかが絶えない。⻑津田は、口ばかりで脚本を最後まで書かず、卒業もする気はなさそう。サークルに入ってきた女子大の1年生・麻衣子と浮気疑惑さえある。そんなとき、カナコは内定先の先輩・吉沢から告白される。編集者になる夢を追うカナコは、長津田の生き方とだんだんとすれ違っていく。

t1315477.movie_title: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.movie_title_jp: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.clean_title_jp: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.synopsis: 1948年、政府が3万人もの島民を虐殺し、長らく隠蔽してきた「済州島四・三事件」。暴力に追い詰められ、極限の中での母娘の命がけの逃避行を描く。
t1315477.synopsis_en: Based on the 'Jeju April 3 Incident,' a massacre in which nearly 30,000 people are said to have been killed but which was covered up for a long time, this drama depicts the flight of a mother and daughter desperately trying to survive while being driven into a corner by unreasonable violence. On April 3, 1948, the 'Jeju April 3 Incident' began when some islanders on Jeju Island, opposed to interference by foreign forces, staged an armed uprising. From October of the same year, the government designated areas more than 5 kilometers from the coastline as 'hostile zones' and issued a proclamation stating, 'Anyone entering or leaving will be shot without condition.' To escape disaster, the villagers head for Hallasan Mountain, which rises in the center of Jeju Island. A-jin, a woman who has to leave the village temporarily, is extremely worried about her 6-year-old daughter Hye-sen, whom she left behind. Meanwhile, in the village, the South Korean army is mercilessly shooting the elderly. Surviving, Hye-sen heads into the mountains alone to find her mother. After miraculously reuniting, the mother and daughter embark on a life-or-death escape to survive. Directed and written by Ha Myeong-mi, who built her career as a screenwriter for commercial films, it vividly portrays the nameless people tossed about by state power. Kim Hyang-gi, known for 'Along with the Gods' and 'Innocent Witness,' stars as A-jin.
t1315477.tmdb_overview_en: Set against the backdrop of the Jeju Uprising in 1948, which was sparked by an armed revolt of islanders fearing the division of Korea into North and South, the film portrays the tragic consequences of an indiscriminate punitive expedition by the South Korean government. Under the guise of an anti-communist campaign, more than 25,000 civilians were slaughtered. Through the story of a mother fiercely protecting her young daughter, the film highlights the resilience and strength of Jeju women amidst the chaos.
t1315477.tmdb_overview_jp: 1948年4月3日、外国勢力による干渉に反発した済州島の一部島民が武装蜂起したことに端を発した「済州島四・三事件」。同年10月より、政府は海岸線から5キロ以上離れた地域を「敵性区域」とみなし、「出入りする者は無条件に射殺する」という布告文を発令した。村人たちは難を逃れるため、済州島の中央にそびえる漢拏山（ハルラサン）を目指す。一時的に村を出ることになった女性アジンは、村に残してきた6歳の娘ヘセンのことが心配でたまらない。その頃、村では韓国軍が老人たちを容赦なく射殺していた。生き残ったヘセンは、母を捜すためたったひとりで山へ向かう。奇跡的に再会を果たした母娘は、生き延びるため命がけの逃避行に出る。

t1464883.synopsis: 独裁政権下のイラク。大統領の誕生日ケーキ係に選ばれた少女は材料集めに奔走するが…。監督の実体験から生まれた、知られざる宝物のような物語！
t1464883.synopsis_en: Lamia, chosen as the 'honorable' cake maker, goes out to town with her grandmother and friend the rooster to search for cake ingredients──
t1464883.tmdb_overview_en: While people across 1990s Iraq struggle to survive the war and food shortages, Saddam Hussein requires each school in the country to prepare a cake to celebrate his birthday. Despite her efforts to avoid getting picked, 9-year-old Lamia is chosen among her classmates. The young girl must now use her wits and imagination to gather ingredients for the mandatory cake or face the consequences.

t1225624.synopsis: 物流センターで働くポルトガル移民・オーロラの単調な日々はスマホの故障を機に変化し…。監督の経験を基に現代の孤独と分断、かすかな希望を描く。
t1225624.synopsis_en: This human drama depicts the loneliness and division in modern society through the daily life of an immigrant woman working in a massive logistics center in Scotland, ultimately finding a faint glimmer of hope. Aurora, a Portuguese immigrant, works as a picker in a huge logistics center on the outskirts of Scotland. Her days are mostly spent walking through countless aisles following scanner instructions and retrieving items from shelves. Conversations with colleagues are limited to brief breaks, and after her shift, she drags her tired body back to a shared house for immigrant workers. Interactions among residents are superficial, relationships never deepen, and her rootless days continue monotonously. One day, Aurora accidentally breaks her smartphone. Losing this modern necessity—her means of workplace communication and her "companion" for passing time—slowly but surely begins to change her daily life. Portuguese-born, Scotland-based Laura Carreira wrote and directed her first feature film based on her own experiences as an immigrant, winning the Best Director Award at the 72nd San Sebastián International Film Festival in 2024.
t1225624.tmdb_overview_en: Aurora, a Portuguese migrant, works as an order picker in a warehouse in Edinburgh, Scotland. Caught between the walls of a huge distribution centre and the solitude of her own room, Aurora tries to seize every opportunity to resist the alienation and isolation that threaten her identity.

t585077.synopsis_en: Ruka, a middle school girl who struggles to put her feelings into words, has no place at home or at school during the long summer vacation, so she visits the aquarium where her father works. There she meets a mysterious boy named Umi, who was said to have been raised by a dugong, and his older brother Sora. Before long, triggered by the three meeting, various phenomena begin to occur across the Earth.
t585077.tmdb_overview_en: Ruka is a young girl whose parents are separated and whose father works in an aquarium. When two boys, Umi and Sora, who were raised in the sea by dugongs, are brought to the aquarium, Ruka feels drawn to them and begins to realize that she has the same sort of supernatural connection to the ocean that they do. Umi and Sora's special power seems to be connected to strange events that have been occurring more and more frequently, such as the appearance of sea creatures far from their home territory and the disappearance of aquarium animals around the world. However, the exact nature of the boys' power and of the abnormal events is unknown, and Ruka gets drawn into investigating the mystery that surrounds her new friends.
t585077.tmdb_overview_jp: 自分の気持ちを言葉にするのが苦手な中学生の琉花は、長い夏休みの間、家にも学校にも居場所がなく、父親の働いている水族館へと足を運ぶ。そこで彼女は、ジュゴンに育てられたという不思議な少年・海と、その兄である空と出会う。やがて3人が出会ったことをきっかけに、地球上でさまざまな現象が起こりはじめる。

n声をあげるということ性犯罪刑法改正の記録.movie_title: 声をあげるということ－性犯罪 刑法改正の記録－
n声をあげるということ性犯罪刑法改正の記録.movie_title_jp: 声をあげるということ－性犯罪 刑法改正の記録－

t41245.movie_title: ペパーミント・キャンディー 4Kレストア
t41245.movie_title_jp: ペパーミント・キャンディー
t41245.clean_title_jp: ペパーミント・キャンディー
t41245.synopsis_en: A human drama that traces twenty years in the life of a man against the backdrop of modern Korean history, winning five major awards including Best Picture at the Grand Bell Awards, South Korea's equivalent of the Oscars. This is the second feature film by director Lee Chang-dong, made in 1999, known for "Oasis" and "Secret Sunshine." Spring, 1999. Kim Yeong-ho, at the depths of despair after losing his job and family, shows up at a picnic with old friends wearing an out-of-place suit. It is the same place he visited twenty years earlier with his first love, Sunim. Standing on the railroad tracks, Yeong-ho shouts "I want to go back!" at an oncoming train, and his life begins to rewind. We see his self-destructed marriage to his wife Hong-ja, his love for Sunim that drew them together but was never fulfilled, and the Gwangju Uprising he witnessed as a soldier. Yeong-ho's journey through memory eventually arrives at the time twenty years ago when his life was most beautiful and pure. The film was released in a 4K-restored digital remaster in 2019 to coincide with the release of Lee Chang-dong's "Burning." A 4K restoration was also screened in 2023 as part of the special retrospective "Lee Chang-dong Retrospective 4K."
t41245.tmdb_overview_en: In the spring of 1999, a group of old friends gather to celebrate their 20 year reunion. Among the group is Yeong-ho, a cold, unhappy man, whose demeanor puts a damper on the festivities. The seriousness of Yeong-ho's depression becomes apparent when he climbs a railroad bridge and looks like he might jump. At this crucial moment, memories of seven crucial episodes from Yeong-ho's past flood his mind.
t41245.tmdb_overview_jp: 1999年春。鉄道の高架下で男ヨンホは全てを失ったいま、過去を振り返っていた。3日前、ヨンホは危篤状態にある初恋の相手、スニムを見舞う。数年前には行きずりのバーのホステスにスニムの面影を見る。さらに3年前、新米刑事のヨンホのもとにスニムがやって来るが、彼はそっけなく追い返してしまう。その4年前には兵役についたヨンホを訪ねたスニムだが面会許可がおりなかった。そしてその1年前、青年ヨンホはスニムとこの高架下で互いの将来を語り合っていた。

t26955.synopsis_en: After serving two years and six months for a hit-and-run incident—following an assault and attempted rape—John-Do is released from prison. When he returns to his family, no one welcomes him warmly, and they don't hide their resentment. One day, he visits the family of the victim he killed in the hit-and-run. However, the family is in the middle of moving, and only a woman named Gong-ju is left behind in the room. She suffers from severe cerebral palsy, leaving her unable to move her limbs freely and with serious speech impairments. Her older brother and his wife had obtained a large apartment for the disabled in her name and moved there, abandoning her. John-Do begins to grow concerned about Gong-ju...
t26955.tmdb_overview_en: A young man released from prison visits the widow of the man he killed drunk-driving and becomes infatuated with his cerebral palsy-stricken daughter.
t26955.tmdb_overview_jp: 暴行、強姦未遂に続いて、今度はひき逃げ事件による2年6ヵ月の刑を終えたばかりのジョンドゥ。出所して家族のもとに戻った彼を、誰も快く迎えようとはせず疎ましい感情を隠そうともしない。ある日、彼はひき逃げで死なせてしまった被害者遺族を訪れる。しかし、一家は引越しの最中で、部屋にはコンジュという女性一人が取り残される。彼女は重度の脳性麻痺のため手足が不自由で発語にも重い障害を抱えていた。兄夫婦は彼女の名義で障害者用の大きなアパートを手に入れ、そこへ移って行ってしまったのだ。ジョンドゥはそんなコンジュのことが気になり始める...。

t348869.tmdb_overview_en: A young couple's announcement of their engagement to their friends is followed by a series of interactions and conflicts that forces everyone to reflect on their lives.

t795811.synopsis_en: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
t795811.tmdb_overview_en: An unexpected love triangle, a seduction trap, and a random encounter are the three episodes, told in three movements to depict three female characters and trace the trajectories between their choices and regrets.
t795811.tmdb_overview_jp: ヘアメイクアーティストである親友のつぐみ(玄理)から好きな男がいると聞かされた、モデルの芽衣子(古川琴音)。だが、その男が元恋人の和明(中島歩)だと知る(第1話『魔法(よりもっと不確か)』)。芥川賞を受賞した大学教授・瀬川(渋川清彦)に落第させられた大学生・佐々木(甲斐翔真)は、復讐(ふくしゅう)を企てる(第2話『扉は開けたままで』)。高校時代の友人である夏子(占部房子)とあや(河井青葉)が、20年ぶりに仙台で再会。当時のことで盛り上がるが、徐々にすれ違っていく(第3話『もう一度』)。

t1295400.synopsis_en: Danish director Anders Thomas Jensen, known for writing "Riders of Justice," "The Good Life," and "After the Wedding," delivers a human drama starring his frequent collaborator Mads Mikkelsen. After serving time for a robbery, Anker is released and reunites with his brother Manfred, who hid a large sum of money during the heist, for the first time in 15 years. However, Manfred not only has forgotten the hiding place but also believes he is John Lennon. The two set out on a journey to find the bag of hidden money, but the trip gradually transforms into a journey of self-reflection for both of them. Mikkelsen plays Manfred, who has lost his memory and believes he is John Lennon, embodying this eccentric and unique character. Anker is played by Nikolaj Lie Kaas, another frequent collaborator of Jensen's. The film had its world premiere in the Out of Competition section of the 2025 Venice International Film Festival and became a massive hit in its native Denmark, breaking the country's all-time box office record for a live-action film.

t400033.synopsis_en:
"I want to film a documentary on Ryuichi Sakamoto for a French television program." In 1983, director Elizabeth Lennard visited Sakamoto in Berlin—where he was attending a David Sylvian recording session—to make this proposal. In May 1984, just as Sakamoto began work on his fourth solo album, *Ongaku Zukan*, filming took place in Tokyo over a brief span of only one week. The five-member French crew, led by Lennard, captured a vivid record of Japan, the city of Tokyo, and the musician Ryuichi Sakamoto.

Following its 1985 completion and French TV broadcast, the film screened at international festivals in Rotterdam, Locarno, and São Paulo. In Japan, it premiered at the inaugural Tokyo International Film Festival on June 9th of that year. While the subsequent VHS and DVD releases were long out of print and difficult to obtain, the original 16mm film was recently discovered in a warehouse and has been digitally restored.

Within its 60-minute runtime, the film captures a 30-something Sakamoto in the studio and in interviews, discussing his upbringing, values, musical philosophy, and culture. It also features footage from Nagisa Oshima’s *Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence* (1983), YMO’s "scatter" concerts, and music videos, while projecting the vibrant energy of 1980s Tokyo—from the Shibuya Scramble to Shinjuku Alta—onto the screen. This legendary documentary, an immersion into the "Sounds of Tokyo" as seen through Sakamoto’s eyes and portrait, finally makes its theatrical debut after nearly 40 years.
t400033.tmdb_overview_en: Documentary about the eclectic Japanese composer Ryuichi Sakamoto during the recording sessions for his 1984 album "Illustrated Musical Encyclopedia".

t1030653.synopsis_en: A documentary recording the recording sessions for "Elis & Tom," the acclaimed 1974 album by Brazilian star singer Elis Regina and Antônio Carlos Jobim (Tom Jobim), one of the founders of bossa nova. Long-buried original footage, unseen for nearly half a century, has been restored in 4K and supplemented with modern interviews. Elis, a national star under Brazil's military regime, and Tom, who gained worldwide fame with the hit "The Girl from Ipanema" in the 1960s and was active in America, clashed badly—the pop star Elis and Tom, who preferred the old, simple music, were a poor fit, and tensions also arose between Tom and Elis's then-husband and arranger, César Camargo Mariano. Through testimonies from family, associates, and band members, along with archival footage, the film depicts their musical differences and the conflicts surrounding the recording. Roberto de Oliveira, who managed Elis and later worked as a director and producer at a TV station, co-directed and appears in the film to testify about Elis's complex state of mind and the chaotic atmosphere at the time.
t1030653.tmdb_overview_en: Elis & Tom is considered one of the most important albums in the history of Brazilian music. Recorded in Los Angeles, in 1974, it was all captured by a team of filmmakers led by director Roberto de Oliveira, who arranged for the duo to meet. The original footage was kept for 45 years until restored and remastered in 2018. The film is also an exciting reunion of the director with the artists and the material he filmed nearly five decades ago.

t1561.movie_title: 少女ムシェット 4Kレストア
t1561.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t1561.synopsis_en: Master filmmaker Robert Bresson's eighth feature, made right after his masterpiece "Au Hasard Balthazar." Based on a novel by French author Georges Bernanos, it starkly and realistically depicts the tragic fate of a young girl through rigorous framing and the actors' minimally restrained performances. 14-year-old Mouchette lives in the French countryside, forced to run the household for her alcoholic father and ill mother, while being cruelly treated by classmates and teachers at school. The unfortunate girl's fate takes a turn for the worse when, one rainy night, she encounters a poacher in the forest, sending her spiraling into further misery and ruin. Nadine Nortier, discovered for this role, plays the protagonist Mouchette, a girl standing on the brink of despair yet harboring a rebellious spirit. Produced in 1967, it was first released in Japan in 1974 by Equipe de Cinema, and again in 1995 by France Eiga Sha. A 4K restored digital remastered version had a revival release in October 2020. Another revival release is scheduled for 2026 as part of the "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t1561.tmdb_overview_en: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.
t1561.tmdb_overview_jp: 14歳のムシェット。家庭の貧困と父の暴力と、同級生の豊かさと美しさ、そして土曜の午後のカンタータの練習に痛めつけられる少女。森番の洩らす秘密を知って、約束を守ると誓ったのに犯されてしまう無垢な肉体。しかし、その秘密すらただの幻影に過ぎなかったと分かって、少女は完全な孤立を味わう。そんな彼女に残された選択は……。ブレッソンが、「田舎司祭の日記」の原作者G・ベルナノスの小説を、自ら脚色して映画化。

t35717.synopsis_en: The fourth feature film by French wunderkind Leos Carax, released eight years after 'The Lovers on the Bridge.' An adaptation of the novel 'Pierre' by 19th-century American author Herman Melville, written the year after his masterpiece 'Moby-Dick.' Shifting the setting to modern-day Paris, it uses emotional imagery and sound to depict the intense, racing love of a man and woman swept up by fate and drawn into despair. Pierre, a young novelist living in a Norman castle, enjoys a wealthy, contented rural life with his mother Marie and fiancée Lucie. One day, Isabelle, a Bosnian refugee claiming to be Pierre's half-sister, appears. Drawn to Isabelle's charm, Pierre abandons everything and heads to Paris with her. Guillaume Depardieu, son of Gérard Depardieu, passionately plays Pierre, and Katerina Golubeva, known for 'Paris at Night,' plays Isabelle. Catherine Deneuve co-stars as Pierre's mother Marie. Cinematography is by Éric Gautier, known for 'My King,' and music is by singer-songwriter Scott Walker. A 4K restored version will be re-released in February 2026.
t35717.tmdb_overview_en: A writer leaves his upper-class life and journeys with a woman claiming to be his sister, and her two friends.

t20108.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t20108.synopsis_en: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t20108.tmdb_overview_en: The story of a donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.

t1378051.movie_title: ビトゥーカ ミルトン・ナシメント フェアウェルツアー
t1378051.synopsis_en: Called the 'Voice of Brazil,' Milton Nascimento, affectionately known as Bituca, led MPB (Brazilian popular music post-bossa nova) alongside contemporaries Gilberto Gil, Caetano Veloso, and Chico Buarque, and collaborated with countless international musicians. This documentary film traces Milton's life and music while following his global farewell concert tour, announced upon turning 80 in 2022. In the first half, Milton's troupe tours Europe and the Americas, receiving ecstatic welcomes. Pat Metheny, Spike Lee, Quincy Jones, and Wayne Shorter speak about Milton, and there are scenes of collaboration with Esperanza Spalding and Herbie Hancock. Milton reflects on his childhood raised as an adopted son, converses with his own adopted child on the road, and shares memories of his benefactor, singer Elis Regina. The second half begins with the landscapes of Minas Gerais, the highland region of inland Brazil that is Milton's home and musical origin. Friends like Chico, Caetano, and Gil, collaborating poets like Márcio Borges and Ronaldo Bastos, and younger musicians who admire Milton, discuss the appeal and depths of his music. Inescapable negative histories, such as racism and Brazil's 20-year military dictatorship starting in 1964, are also revealed. Then, the farewell concert finale approaches: the concert at Mineirão, the football stadium in Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais. Members of Clube da Esquina (Corner Club), the title of a landmark 1972 album and the name for the family of Minas musicians centered around Milton—Lô Borges, Beto Guedes, Wagner Tiso, and Toninho Horta—share behind-the-scenes stories and perform together.
t1378051.tmdb_overview_en: Milton Nascimento is a singer, a songwriter and a connoisseur of multiple instruments.  Music is at the core of his being. He is also considered one of the most important Brazilian artists in its history, with musical partnerships (and friendships) with all of Brazil’s greats, and several Grammys to his name. The artist’s history and legacy are explored in this film, whose starting point is Nascimento’s farewell tour.

t58833.synopsis_en: A French noir directed by Claude Berri in 1983, known for 'The Old Man and the Child' and 'Jean de Florette'/'Manon des Sources,' which became a huge hit in France attracting nearly 4 million viewers. Set in the Parisian underworld, it vividly portrays the loneliness and sorrow of those cast out from the city through a tale of friendship and revenge between a lonely middle-aged man and a young drug dealer. In the 18th arrondissement of Paris, one night, a young man named Bensoussan, of Jewish and Arab descent, flees into the gas station where Lambert, an alcoholic middle-aged man, works. Bensoussan begins visiting Lambert frequently, and Lambert starts looking after him. However, Bensoussan, a drug dealer, is killed by two men on a motorcycle. Lambert swears revenge, takes a gun, and heads out into the night. French national comedian Coluche plays the protagonist Lambert, and Richard Anconina, known for 'The Pistol and the Boy,' plays Bensoussan. At the 9th César Awards, Coluche won Best Actor, and Anconina won Best Supporting Actor and Most Promising Actor. Based on the novel by Alain Page, known for 'The Sun Knows,' the screenplay was co-written by Page and director Berri. Scheduled for a revival release in Japan in July 2026 in a 4K digital version.
t58833.tmdb_overview_en: In the 18th Arrondissement of Paris, Lambert, an aloof garage manager working the night shift at a petrol station spends his time drinking on the job, content in his own company. One night, Bensoussan, a small-time drug pusher in dire straits falls in on a stolen moped pretending to need a spark plug. The two men develop an unlikely friendship.

t10226.tmdb_overview_en: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.
t10226.tmdb_overview_jp: マリーとアレックスは女友達同士。 勉強に専念するために、二人はアレックスの両親のいる田舎の一軒家に行く事にした。 それは周囲をトウモロコシ畑が取り囲む孤立した一軒家だった。 到着後アレックスの家族に挨拶したあと、自分にあてがわれた部屋にマリーはいた。 家の前にトラックがやってきて、車中から降り立った一人の男性が、ドアベルを鳴らし出した。

t9539.movie_title: マーターズ 4Kデジタルリマスター
t9539.synopsis_en:
Pain and salvation. Rejection and worship. Despair, and then ecstasy. The world's fastest theatrical release—you will become a "witness" to film history. Since its French release in 2008, 'Martyrs' has sparked controversy with its brutally intense depictions, while leading audiences to an unpredictable conclusion that borders on the sublime, igniting fierce debate worldwide. The pinnacle of the "French horror" movement that dominated an era, and the masterpiece of the eccentric genius director Pascal Laugier, now revived in the Reiwa era with a 4K digital remaster in the world's fastest theatrical release. The origin of Laugier's consistent portrayal of women with the conviction to face despair, this film pushes terror and philosophical depth to their absolute limits, venturing into realms beyond human comprehension. Even 18 years later, it remains undimmed, continuing to exert immense influence on contemporary French filmmakers including Coralie Fargeat's 'The Substance' and Julia Ducournau's 'TITANE'. What awaits beyond the pain swirling with conflicting emotions is an unknown realm no other film has ever reached. *Please note: This theater will screen the 2K version.
France in the early 1970s. A missing girl named Lucie is found wandering the streets, battered and emaciated. She had been imprisoned, tortured, and abused by someone for a long time, and escaped on her own. However, there were no signs of sexual abuse, and the motive for the crime remained unknown... 15 years later, one morning, a doorbell suddenly rings at a peaceful family home surrounded by forest. When the homeowner opens the door, Lucie (Mylène Jampanoï) stands there with a hunting rifle. Convinced she has finally found the person who abused her, she pulls the trigger of revenge. Anna (Morjana Alaoui), Lucie's best friend, receives a phone call from her and rushes to the house, turning away in horror at the carnage. The two set about disposing of the bodies and preparing to leave. But then, they are confronted with an unimaginable truth.
Admission: General/Student/Senior 1,700 yen, HC discount 1,000 yen. *Other discounts, various invitation and courtesy tickets, and T-tickets cannot be used.
t9539.tmdb_overview_en: A young woman’s quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tortured her as a child leads her and her best friend, also a victim of child abuse, on a terrifying journey into a living hell of depravity.
t9539.tmdb_overview_jp: 1970年代のフランス、何者かに拉致監禁され、長期にわたり虐待を受け続けた少女リュシー（ジェシー・パム）は自力で逃げ出し、傷だらけの状態で発見される。養護施設に収容された彼女は心を閉ざしていたが、同年代の少女アンナ（エリカ・スコット）にだけは心を許していた。15年後、リュシー（ミレーヌ・ジャンパノイ）は自分を監禁した相手を発見し、猟銃を手に犯人宅を訪れる。

nあなたはデジタル修復版.synopsis: . 『あなたは•••••（デジタル修復版）』 「あなたにとって幸福とは何ですか?」ハンドマイク一つしか持たない素人の女子大生が、まるで機械のように、決められた17の質問を町ゆく人にぶつけていく。フランスの映画監督・人類学者ジャン・ルーシュの「シネマ・ヴェリテ」に影響されたディレクター萩元晴彦が、盟友・寺山と仕掛けた記念碑的作品。デモ隊の先頭、挙式中の花嫁、在日米兵など取材対象は様々。しかしなぜだろう、それらの問いは、観客である我々自身に向けられている気がしてならない。 『日の丸（HDリマスター版）』 建国記念の日が初めて施行される2日前、寺山と萩元は『あなたは•••••』と同じ手法を用いて「愛国心」をテーマに制作したのが本作。「日の丸といったらまず何を思い浮かべますか?」「家庭と祖国のどちらを愛していますか?」といった質問を矢継ぎ早に投げかけていく。放送後には“偏向番組だ”として郵政省が TBS に事情聴取を行った。入社して受けた新人研修で本作に衝撃を受けた私は、拙作『日の丸~寺山修司40年目の挑発~』を監督するに至る。 . .
nあなたはデジタル修復版.synopsis_en: "You Are... (Digital Restoration)" — "What is happiness to you?" An amateur female college student armed with nothing but a handheld microphone fires seventeen predetermined questions at passersby like a machine. Influenced by French filmmaker and anthropologist Jean Rouch's "cinema vérité," director Haruhiko Hagimoto, in collaboration with his ally Terayama, created this monumental work. The subjects are diverse: the front of a demonstration march, a bride during her wedding ceremony, American soldiers stationed in Japan. Yet somehow, these questions feel as though they are being directed at us, the viewers. "Hinomaru (HD Remaster)" — Two days before the first observance of National Foundation Day, Terayama and Hagimoto used the same method as "You Are..." to create this work on the theme of "patriotism." They rapidly posed questions such as "What first comes to mind when you hear 'Hinomaru'?" and "Which do you love more, your family or your homeland?" After broadcast, the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications summoned TBS for questioning, calling it a "biased program." Having been shocked by this work during new-employee training, I went on to direct my own film, "Hinomaru: Terayama Shuji's Provocation 40 Years Later."

t52686.synopsis: アイヌの伝承を題材にした人形劇「春楡の上に太陽」を基に、少年ホルスと悪魔の戦いを描く。長篇初演出の高畑勲は、スタッフに積極的にアイデアを募って宮崎駿ら若手を率い、幾度もの制作中断や上層部との対立を乗り越え、勧善懲悪を超えた重層的なドラマへと到達した。少女ヒルダの心理描写は出色で、森康二の繊細な作画が奥行きを生んでいる。
t52686.synopsis_en: Director Isao Takahata's feature-length debut, made in 1968 during his time at Toei Animation. Based on the puppet play 'The Sun on the Spring Elm' by Kazuo Fukazawa, it depicts the brave boy Hols, entrusted with the Sun Sword, confronting a demon. Hols lives with his father in a remote natural setting. Rescued from a wolf attack by the rock giant Moog, Hols receives the Sun Sword embedded in Moog's shoulder. After losing his father, Hols follows his father's dying wish and sets out for a village where people live, but is captured by the terrifying demon Grunwald and thrown off a cliff. Washing up in a village, Hols defeats a giant pike that has been plaguing the villagers and becomes a hero. One day, he meets a lonely girl named Hilda in a ruined village and brings her back, but... Scene design, art design, and key animation were handled by Hayao Miyazaki, animation direction by Yasuo Otsuka, and key animation by Koji Mori. It was released as part of the 'Toei Manga Parade' (Toei Manga Festival) in the summer of 1968.
t52686.tmdb_overview_en: Young Horus lives in a mythical Scandinavia of the Iron Age. Recovering the stolen Sword of the Sun from a rock giant, he learns he must travel to the lands of his ancestors, encountering the beautiful but enigmatic Hilda as his journey leads to a series of adventures.
t52686.tmdb_overview_jp: 海辺に父と二人で住むホルスは、岩男のモーグの肩に刺さっていた二本の剣を手に入れた。 その剣は太陽の剣と呼ばれる名剣で、その剣を鍛え上げ、使いこなせるようになった時、ホルスは太陽の王子 とよばようとモーグは言う。 父を失ったホルスは、一切合切を焼くと、父の遺言に従い人々のいる北の村に向かってコロとともに舟出した 。再びこの地に帰ることはない。 途中ホルスは悪魔グルンワルドに弟になれと誘われるが断って、崖から落とされてしまう。ホルスは 倒れたまま流氷にのって村に流れ着いた。ホルスは村の一員として受入れられるかに思えたが、グルンワルドのたくらみで村に送り込まれた一人の 少女ヒルダのために、村人達の不信を買い、とうとう村を追い出されてしまう。悪魔が勝つかに見えた。 しかしヒルダの心の奥底には、密かに人間らしさへの憧れが兆していた。悪魔の攻撃が始まった。ホルスは 人々を励まし、力をあわせて太陽の剣を鍛え上げ、ついに悪魔を倒した。ヒルダも仲間に受け入れられる。

n中西太背番号6デジタル修復版.synopsis: . 『中西太 背番号６（デジタル修復版）』 若くして西鉄ライオンズの監督となった天才野球選手、中西太。1964年6月7日、福岡県平和台球場で行われた西鉄ライオンズ対東映フライヤーズ第15回戦の実況中継に、貧困から這い上がった中西の栄光と孤独に満ちた半生を絡ませていく。「プロ野球のスカウトというのは今様の人買いであり、プロ野球の球場は、買われた若者たちの人生を懸けた孤独な劇場なのである」この冒頭ナレーションだけでもう、寺山の仕事だとわかってしまう。 『サラブレッドーわが愛―大障碍の記録―（HDリマスター版）』 1964年10月11日、千葉県中山競馬場で行われた大障碍レース。フジノオーとタカライジンの対決を軸に、騎手、調教師、厩務員、そしてサラブレッドの人生を描く。リマスターされた映像を観た私は、得も言われぬ感動に打ち震えた。馬の毛並みの美しさ、山本直純が手掛ける劇伴の艶やかさ、そして熾烈なレースを繰り広げるクライマックスの、一切ピントを狂わすことなく競走馬を捉え続けるカメラワークの超絶技巧に。これらのディテールこそが、本作の真価を謡いあげている。 . .
n中西太背番号6デジタル修復版.synopsis_en: "Nakanishi Futoshi, Number 6 (Digital Restoration)" — Futoshi Nakanishi, a genius baseball player who became manager of the Nishitetsu Lions at a young age. The live broadcast of the 15th game between the Nishitetsu Lions and the Toei Flyers on June 7, 1964, at Heiwadai Stadium in Fukuoka Prefecture, is interwoven with the glory and loneliness of Nakanishi's life, who rose from poverty. "Professional baseball scouts are nothing but human traffickers of the modern age, and the professional baseball stadium is a lonely theater where purchased young men stake their lives." Just this opening narration makes it immediately clear that this is Terayama's work. "Thoroughbred: My Love — Record of the Grand Steeplechase (HD Remaster)" — The Grand Steeplechase held on October 11, 1964, at Nakayama Racecourse in Chiba Prefecture. Centered on the showdown between Fujino-O and Takaraijin, the film depicts the lives of jockeys, trainers, stable hands, and the thoroughbreds themselves. Watching the remastered footage, I trembled with indescribable emotion — at the beauty of the horses' coats, the brilliance of Naozumi Yamamoto's musical score, and the extraordinary camerawork in the climax that captures the racehorses without ever losing focus for even a moment. These details are what truly extol the value of this work.

n勝敗第一部第二部デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭.synopsis: 萩元がテレビの“中継性”を見出したという『第一部』。坂田栄寿名人と林海峯八段の第四期囲碁名人戦の模様を4台のカメラと同時録音で収録。最小限のナレーションと両者の表情・手つき・呟きなどから、緊張感漂う現場の時間そのものを伝える。しかし翌週放送された『第二部』は一変、物語は思いもよらない展開を見せ、THE 寺山作品へと変貌していく。ヒッチコック『サイコ』のような巧みな構成に貴方も翻弄されるがいい。 . .
n勝敗第一部第二部デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭.synopsis_en: "Victory and Defeat, Parts One and Two (Digital Restoration)" TBS Retrospective Film Festival — Part One, in which Hagimoto discovered the "live broadcast quality" of television. The fourth Go Meijin tournament match between Meijin Eiju Sakata and 8-dan Rin Kaiho is recorded with four cameras and simultaneous audio. Through minimal narration and the expressions, hand movements, and murmurs of both players, it conveys the very time of the tense scene itself. However, Part Two, broadcast the following week, takes a complete turn — the story unfolds in an unexpected direction, transforming into a quintessential Terayama work. You too will be tossed about by its clever structure, reminiscent of Hitchcock's "Psycho."

t86814.synopsis_en: A documentary by Belgian director Chantal Akerman, who revolutionized cinema with 'Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles,' a portrait of an ordinary housewife's daily routine. In this film, she reads letters from her mother over footage capturing the landscapes of 1970s New York. By layering her mother's affectionate words over the bleak cityscapes of New York—alleyways, cars on avenues, people waiting for trains on station platforms, and underground passages—the film highlights the alienation of urban life and the distance from family far away. In Japan, it received its theatrical premiere at the 'Chantal Akerman Film Festival 2023' (April 7–27, 2023, Human Trust Cinema Shibuya), screened together with 'Saute ma ville.'
t86814.tmdb_overview_en: Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.

t1226141.synopsis: 葬儀業に転職したトウサンは葬儀道士の師匠と衝突するが…。伝統の葬儀式「破地獄」を通じ、亡き者と生きる者の尊厳を描いた、香港の大ヒット作。
t1226141.synopsis_en: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.
t1226141.tmdb_overview_en: Despite the pandemic sending most industries into recession, debt-ridden wedding planner Dominic (Dayo WONG) gets a miraculous chance to turn things around when a funeral planner retires and passes the baton to him. His creative gimmicks for funerals help his business find unexpected success, but Dominic’s biggest obstacle is winning the approval of respected and sternly traditional Taoist priest, Master Man (Michael HUI). After some unordinary funerals, Dominic gradually understands Master Man’s code of ethics and the meaning behind each farewell.
t1226141.tmdb_overview_jp: 疫病が猛威をふるい経済が低迷するなか、葬儀社に転職したダオシェン（ダヨ・ウォン）。当初は先輩のマン（マイケル・ホイ）と衝突するダオシェンだったが、彼と仕事をするうちに人生観に変化が生まれていく。ダヨ・ウォンとマイケル・ホイ、香港映画界の二大コメディアンが『マジック・タッチ』（1992）以来32年ぶりに共演とあって、撮影時から大きな話題となっている注目作。「破地獄」とは、故人の霊を地獄から救い出すための道教の儀式を意味している。

t1457842.synopsis: バルセロナ郊外バルボナ地区に長年暮らす人々と新世代の移民たち。自然に恵まれた理想郷のようなこの地で共生する彼らの生活を映したドキュメンタリー。
t1457842.synopsis_en: A new feature film from director José Luis Guerín, who captivated the world with 'In the City of Sylvia' (2007) and was called 'the most outstanding filmmaker in contemporary Spain' by fellow Spanish director Víctor Erice. Despite his sparse output, Guerín continues to create masterpieces that lightly transcend the boundaries between fiction and documentary. This is his long-awaited new film, his first in ten years since 'The Academy of Muses' (2015), now arriving in Japan. To commemorate the release of 'The Good Valley Story,' the beautiful masterpiece 'In the City of Sylvia' will also be revived. Please enjoy Guerín's world on the big screen. The Vallbona district, located on the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. This place, named 'The Good Valley,' is surrounded by rivers and railway tracks, an isolated land left behind by development, yet it also seems like an ideal paradise blessed with nature so rich it's hard to believe it's near a big city. Here, families who moved in from the mid-20th century live together with a new generation of immigrants who have arrived recently. Although their cultures and lifestyles differ, the children play together in the river, and everyone eats, drinks, sings, and dances well, finding a moment of peace. A new railway expansion plan is proposed for this urban oasis. A residents' information meeting is held, and some people are forced to relocate...
t1457842.tmdb_overview_en: In a peripheral neighbourhood, where the rural and urban worlds meet, the houses of the first migrants who arrived after the post-war period coexist with the new blocks of the dormitory city, where the latest wave of migration is concentrated. This humble corner is now an authentic global village. Good Valley Stories is a sum of constructs, of social, generational and identity, urban and ecological conflicts, but it is also a calm and humanistic look at today’s world.
t1457842.tmdb_overview_jp: スペイン、バルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。“よき⾕”と名付けられたこの場所は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島でありながら、⼤都市の近くとは思えないほどの豊かな⾃然に恵まれた理想郷のようでもある。ここには 20 世紀半ばから移り住んだ住⺠の家族と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移⺠たちが共に暮らしている。⽂化や⽣活スタイルは異なるものの、⼦供たちはともに川で遊び、誰もがよく⾷べて飲んで、歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスに、新しく鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がった。住⺠説明会が開かれ、⼀部の⼈々は⽴ち退きを迫られるが……。

t78463.synopsis_en: 1938. The Kaufmanns, a family of Jewish art dealers, secretly owned a Michelangelo painting so precious that even Mussolini coveted it. One day, the family's son Viktor reveals the painting's whereabouts to his best friend Rudi. Rudi, who had been sympathetic to the Nazis, informs on them in order to advance in the military, and the family is stripped of the painting and sent to a concentration camp.
t78463.tmdb_overview_en: Poland 1943: An unlikely pair - a concentration camp prisoner and a captain in Hitler's notorious SS - free themselves from the wreckage of a crashed SS airplane. The two appear to be strangely familiar with each other and the extent of their extraordinary relationship is thrillingly revealed.
t78463.tmdb_overview_jp: 1938年。ユダヤ人画商一族・カウフマン家はムッソリーニも欲するほどの国宝級の代物・ミケランジェロの絵を密かに所有していた。ある日、一家の息子ヴィクトルは親友ルディに絵の在りかを教えてしまう。ナチスに傾倒していたルディは軍で昇進するためにそれを密告、一家は絵を奪われ収容所へと送られる。

t525019.synopsis: 物語は九州・博多男児の晴れ舞台「祇園山笠」から始まる。六平は足を怪我した父に変わって、 生まれて初めて山笠を担ぐ。そして山笠が終わり、普段の学校生活に戻った六平と親友の道雄、真澄が集まり決まって話すことは、未だ神秘のベールに包まれた女性の体についてだった。この3人組とヒロイン類子を軸に、中学生たちの淡い恋、性への目覚め、悲しき別れ、ケンカ…。あらゆる青春の沸点を詰め込んだ物語が展開する。
t525019.synopsis_en: The story begins with the Gion Yamakasa festival, the grand stage for the boys of Hakata, Kyushu. Rokuhei carries the yamakasa for the first time in his life, taking the place of his father who injured his leg. After the festival ends and Rokuhei returns to everyday school life, he gathers with his best friends Michio and Masumi, and what they always talk about is the female body, still shrouded in a veil of mystery. Centered on this trio and the heroine Ruiko, the story unfolds packed with the faint first loves, sexual awakenings, sorrowful partings, and fights of junior high school students—every boiling point of youth.
t525019.tmdb_overview_en: Based on the comic by Housei Hasegawa

t1211257.synopsis: 高校卒業を目前に控えた健次は、仮出所で帰って来た片腕のやくざ・安男に再会した。組の仲間が、組長が死んでしまって組はつぶれたと話しても、安男は一向に信じようとしないばかりかその仲間を撃ち殺してしまう。自分だけにつらい思いをさせて出所したら雲隠れか、と怒った安男は、健次に妹のユリと大切なショルダーバッグを預け、組長の消息を追いかける。ユリを預かった健次は安男との待ち合わせ場所である山中のドライブインに行くが…。
t1211257.synopsis_en: Kenji, on the verge of graduating from high school, is reunited with Yasuo, a one-armed yakuza who has returned on parole. Even when his gang comrades tell him that the gang has disbanded because the boss died, Yasuo refuses to believe it and even shoots one of the comrades dead. Angry that he was the only one who suffered and that they went into hiding after his release, Yasuo entrusts his sister Yuri and an important shoulder bag to Kenji, and goes off in search of the boss's whereabouts. Kenji, now looking after Yuri, heads to a roadside diner in the mountains—the meeting place with Yasuo—but...
t1211257.tmdb_overview_en: Claire and Ned are driving at night on their way to see family and show off the new addition to their family - a child. But while changing a flat tire, Ned is severely injured. The more time that passes, the more paranoid Ned becomes, convinced that something sinister lurks outside.

t107547.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t107547.synopsis: かいせつ 竜馬が暗殺されるまでの3日間を斬新な切り口で描く異色の幕末もの。原田、優作ら時代を象徴するキャスティングの中で、中川も存在感を発揮する。
t107547.synopsis_en: A distinctive late-Edo period drama depicting the three days leading up to Ryoma's assassination from a fresh angle. Among a cast emblematic of the era, including Harada and Yusaku, Nakagawa also makes his presence felt.
t107547.tmdb_overview_en: Story of the last three days in the life of Sakamoto Ryoma (1836-1867), the imperial loyalist who tried to unite the Choshu and Satsuma clans and prepared the way for the Meiji Restoration (1868).
t107547.tmdb_overview_jp: 慶応3（1867）年11月13日。雨降る京都の街並みを走るひとりの男がいた。彼の名は、坂本龍馬。土佐藩を脱藩して海援隊を組織し、薩長同盟の斡旋にも尽力した彼の奔走のおかげで、ひと月前の10月14日、大政奉還がついに実現。日本の体制は大きく変わりつつあったが、それを快く思わない連中が、龍馬の命を付け狙っていた。龍馬の元の同志である陸援隊隊長・中岡慎太郎も、龍馬を自らの手で殺すかどうか、大いに悩む。

t56335.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t56335.synopsis: かいせつ 熊野で実際に起きた凄惨な事件から着想し中上が脚本を書き上げた衝撃作。北大路が自滅していく男を壮絶に演じ、その情婦役・太地の激情ぶりも圧巻。
t56335.synopsis_en: A shocking work scripted by Nakagami, inspired by a gruesome real incident in Kumano. Kitaoji delivers a devastating portrayal of a man spiraling toward self-destruction, while Taichi's fiery performance as his mistress is equally overwhelming.
t56335.tmdb_overview_en: Tatsuo, a reverent lumberjack, seeks to disrupt plans to build a marine park on his family land, instead promoting his traditions in reactionary ways.

t489879.movie_title: ≒草間彌生 わたし大好き
t489879.movie_title_original: 草間彌生~わたし大好き~
t489879.synopsis_en: A documentary that records the creative activities and daily life of internationally acclaimed avant-garde artist Yayoi Kusama over a year and a half, delving into the essence of the Kusama world that captivates so many people. The film closely follows the production of her latest series of 50 monochrome F100-sized works, 'Love Is Forever,' vividly capturing the precious moments from a blank white canvas to the completion of each piece. The fifth installment in the documentary film series '≒ (Nearly Equal)' that spotlights unique artists.
t489879.tmdb_overview_en: Captures the avant-garde artist Yayoi Kusamas creative process as she diligently works to complete her series of 50 large monochrome drawings. As her work comes to life, one can witness the essence of her art as it wells up in the conflict between life, death, and love.
t489879.tmdb_overview_jp: 世界的に高い評価を受ける前衛芸術家・草間彌生の創作活動と日常を1年半に渡って記録し、多くの人々を魅了する草間ワールドの真髄に迫るドキュメンタリー。彼女の最新作であるF100号のモノクロ作品シリーズ“愛はとこしえ”50作の制作風景に密着し、真っ白なキャンパスから作品が完成するまでの貴重な瞬間を克明に映し出す。個性的なアーティストたちにスポットを当てたドキュメンタリー映画シリーズ「≒（ニアイコール）」第5弾。

t1662957.movie_title: TRUE KYOHEI SAKAGUCHI SHOW 坂口恭平生活
t1662957.movie_title_jp: TRUE KYOHEI SAKAGUCHI SHOW 坂口恭平生活
t1662957.movie_title_en: TRUE KYOHEI SAKAGUCHI SHOW 坂口恭平生活
t1662957.clean_title_jp: TRUE KYOHEI SAKAGUCHI SHOW 坂口恭平生活
t1662957.movie_title_original: TRUE KYOHEI SAKAGUCHI SHOW 坂口恭平生活
t1662957.synopsis_en:
A documentary capturing the life and creative output of Kyohei Sakaguchi, a multi-disciplinary artist active as a writer, painter, musician, and architect. Born in Kumamoto Prefecture in 1978, Sakaguchi is known for numerous works, including *0-Yen House*, a photo book documenting the dwellings of the homeless, and *How to Build an Independent State*, which reexamines the role of government and the nation. In 2011, spurred by a lack of trust in the government’s response to the Great East Japan Earthquake, Sakaguchi declared the establishment of a "New Government" in his hometown of Kumamoto and began accepting evacuees at his base, "Zero Center." Since 2012, he has made his personal phone number public to continue "Inocchi no Denwa" (Telephone of Life), a telephone consultation service for those struggling with suicidal ideation. Sakaguchi is also open about his own experience with bipolar disorder, at times sinking into deep depression to confront himself.

New director Yuki Komiya, making his feature debut, began following Sakaguchi over a long period after visiting a solo exhibition and filming a live performance as an audience member. The film records Sakaguchi's daily life in Kumamoto, as well as his exhibitions and events across the country. Even as filming was interrupted when Sakaguchi fell into a deep depression during production, the documentary vividly captures the process of him giving birth to new words while facing a fundamental "loneliness" he has carried since before his childhood. Director Komiya personally edited footage previously released on YouTube to complete this theatrical version.
t1662957.tmdb_overview_jp: 坂口恭平。作家、画家、音楽家、建築家、新政府初代内閣総理大臣、“いのっちの電話”相談員、そして躁鬱人。偶然の巡り合わせから坂口恭平に密着することになって間もない 2023 年夏、坂口は深い鬱に落ち、連絡が取れなくなる。半年後の2024 年春、長い鬱が明けた坂口のアトリエを再び訪ねると、彼は幼年期以前の根源的な“さびしさ”と向き合っていたと語り出す。それは現実なのか、小説なのか？ “さびしさ”の正体とは？ 坂口が鬱の中で向き合い続けた内的世界から、言葉や絵、音楽が新たに生まれ落ちていく。坂口恭平の生活の記録が再開した。

t126150.movie_title_jp: 長靴をはいた猫 80日間世界一周
t126150.movie_title_en: Puss 'n Boots Travels Around the World
